articleTitle: An Accurate Prediction of Coronary Heart Disease Using Ensemble Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Coronary Heart-disease (CHD) is one the foremost causes of death globally, making the accurate recognition of it vital. Machine-learning (ML) and deep-learning (DL) are two of the newest technologies being put to use in the healthcare industry. This paper uses a risk factor method to examine how CHD can be predicted. K-Nearest-Neighbors, Binary-Logistic Classification, and Naïve-Bayes are only few of the predictive methods that are measured by accuracy, recall, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves for evaluation. Ensemble modeling strategies including bagging, boosting, and stacking are contrasted to these foundational classifiers. The efficacy of using ensemble approaches to enhance coronary heart disease prediction was investigated using a comparative analytical methodology. The ‘Cardiovascular-Disease Dataset,’ which includes 80,000 records of patient data for CHD, is used to evaluate the modeling techniques. It is demonstrated that bagged models, on average, are more accurate than their non-bagged counterparts by the margin of 1.99 percentage points. The highest accuracy of all models was 76.5%, but the AUC for the boosted models was 0.78. Accuracy of 75.1% was achieved by the stacked model consisting of KNN, random-forest classifier, and SVM. In addition, data-analytic methods and K-Folds cross-validation were used to verify the tested models' performance.

articleTitle: Detection of Encrypted and Malicious Network Traffic using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Network traffic has increased by a factor of ten due to the meteoric rise of the Internet. The prevalence of encryption methods makes it difficult to identify malicious traffic. Reason being, without being able to decipher encrypted traffic, conventional detection methods are useless. Recent work on detecting harmful encrypted traffic has concentrated on feature extraction and the selection of deep learning techniques rather than on breaking the encryption itself. For the most part, today's edge node devices are responsible for processing massive amounts of data, extracting critical elements of network traffic, and then sending that information on to a cloud server. However, how to more rapidly and precisely identify network traffic remains a hard topic, as mobile terminal tools performance in discovering and categorizing encrypted &malicious traffic lags after. We develop a model of a convolutional-neural-network (CNN) that integrates normalized and attention processes; this model is called I-D-CNN with hexadecimal data (HexCNN-ID). Global-Attention-Block (GAB) and Category-Attention-Block (CAB) are modules of the attention mechanism that help identify and categorize network traffic. Our algorithm is able to recognize most types of network-traffic, plus encrypted &malicious traffic data, by mining efficient load information from hexadecimal network traffic. An average accuracy of 98.8% was found during experimental testing. Our methodology has the potential to significantly enhance the reliability of traffic data recognition in networks.

articleTitle: Respiratory Sound Analysis for Lung Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Lung diseases are the major global health concern, often necessitating accurate and timely diagnosis for effective management and treatment. The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that lung disorders were causing an increasing number of deaths in India, accounting for 11% of all fatalities. A kind of lung illness claimed the lives of 142.09 people out of every 10,000. Through the use of deep learning algorithms and sound wave analysis, this study presents a novel method for detecting lung disease. This approach promises to deliver a non-invasive, economical, and reliable tool for accurate disease diagnosis by utilizing the rich information conveyed in lung sounds. The research entails gathering lung sound recordings from a wide range of people, including healthy controls and people with a variety of respiratory diseases. These recordings have undergone careful curation to create a comprehensive collection that captures the auditory characteristics of lung illnesses. Advanced signal processing techniques are used to extract pertinent data, capturing crucial traits including wheezing, crackles, and patterns of airflow.

articleTitle: Dynamic Inspection Algorithm Based on Substation Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: As an important part of power system, the running state of substation equipment is very important to the safety and stability of power grid. Traditional static inspection methods are time-consuming and energy-consuming, so it is of great significance to develop an efficient and accurate dynamic inspection algorithm for improving inspection efficiency. This paper aims to explain a dynamic inspection algorithm of substation inspection robot to optimize the efficiency and accuracy of inspection process. Through comparative experiments, it is found that the algorithm has significantly improved the inspection time and resource utilization compared with the traditional static inspection method. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional method, the inspection robot using dynamic inspection algorithm saves about 28% time in small substation, 29% time in medium substation, 33% time in large substation and 37.5% time in super-large substation. In addition, the dynamic inspection algorithm can flexibly adjust the inspection path according to real-time data and environmental changes, and improve inspection efficiency and resource utilization. Therefore, the dynamic inspection algorithm has practical application potential and can bring significant improvement to the inspection process of substation.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis Of T-Type 3-Level Inverter In Pv-Fuel Cell Hybrid Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This work presents the concert analysis of 3-level T -type inverter for the application of hybrid generation system. High levels of harmonic distortion are produced by a conventional two-level inverter, which results in poor power quality. Hence, T -type three-level inverter is proposed in this work to overcome disadvantages in conventional inverter. Hybrid generation system comprises of Photovoltaic (PV) and Fuel cell. The implementation of a Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) scheme is necessary in order to optimize power extraction from a photovoltaic (PV) system. Hence, the incremental conductance method is adopted for this system. Controlling the switches of a grid integrated 3-level T - Type inverter is accomplished through the application of a Carrier Based (CB) Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) scheme. The Proportional and Integral (PI) controller has been chosen for the task of regulating the voltage of the capacitor. The performance parameters including dc link voltage, active power, reactive power, power factor and total harmonic distortion (THD) are verified using projected inverter and compared with conventional two-level inverter. Matlab Simulink is used as the development environment for the work that was proposed.

articleTitle: A Clustering Model for Collision Avoidance and Prevention of Packet Loss in a Biosensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The packet loss in a biosensor network makes it difficult to continuously monitor and transfer patient information to medical centers. It lacks in complete analysis of the disease. This research article aims to propose a collision free biosensor network that prevents packet loss. We propose a K-Means clustering with the Euclidean distance and elbow method for optimal number of clusters creation in the biosensor network. The biosensors communicate with a cluster head, and the cluster head directs the messages of each cluster to the nano-router. When the information moves up the hierarchy, from the cluster head to the nano-router and then to the micro-gateway, redundant messages are eliminated. While the active biosensors interact with the cluster head, the remaining biosensors enter a low-power sleep mode to reduce the total energy consumption and boost the system's efficiency. We obtained an energy efficiency of 98% and a packet loss rate of 0.5%.

articleTitle: Hand Sign Language Detection Using Deep Learning and Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This work presents an innovative system/app designed to assist individuals with visual or hearing impairments in communicating with the outside world using American Sign Language (ASL). By leveraging machine learning and image processing techniques, the proposed system captures and processes hand gestures, enabling the optimal transliteration of sign language alphabets and numbers into machine-readable English text. The system employs deep learning or random forest algorithms to classify the gestures, followed by mapping them to specific alphabets or numbers. The resulting text is presented audibly, bridging the communication gap and facilitating interactions between ASL users and those unfamiliar with sign language. Through the integration of technology, this work aims to enhance inclusivity and accessibility for individuals having disabilities, fostering greater engagement and interaction with the wider world.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Parkinson's Disease using Hybrid Ensemble Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) presents a substantial global health challenge characterized by difficulties in movement, coordination, and muscle regulation. Diagnosis primarily relies on identifying symptoms like shaking, stiffness, slow movements, and trouble walking. PD can also impact speech, leading to changes in breathing, vocal quality, and volume. Research suggests that alterations in speech could be an early indication of PD, motivating the use of a specialized Parkinson's dataset for speech analysis in this specific research. The research investigates the use of diverse machine learning models, such as Random Forest classification, K Nearest Neighbors, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machine, combined with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to assess and diagnose PD based on speech characteristics. These models demonstrate promising accuracy levels ranging from 80% to 91.5% when tested on the PD dataset. Ongoing research endeavors aim to develop more efficient combined models to improve overall performance. By amalgamating these models, the study achieves a peak accuracy of 91.5%, enabling precise identification of the disease.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Electrical Automation Control System with the Blessing of Intelligent Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In response to the shortcomings of single system function and insufficient information in the current electrical automation control system. This article proposes an intelligent technology to comprehensively optimize the design of electrical automation control systems, achieving information data sharing, channel sharing, and functional complementarity, which has played a certain role in improving the debugging rate of control systems, reducing the failure rate and maintenance costs of electrical equipment. Firstly, using big data to intervene in the automatic control system, dividing indicators according to the requirements of the automatic control system, and then automatically detecting the accuracy of the control system, eliminating fault rates, reducing maintenance costs, forming an intelligent automatic control system solution, and conducting a comprehensive analysis of the automatic control system. Through data simulation, we can conclude that intelligent technology is superior to the original automatic control system in terms of accuracy and troubleshooting.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion Battery State of Health Estimation Using Support Vector Regression(SVR)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Thanks to recent advancements in lithium-ion (Li-ion) storage technology, the automotive industry is transforming. Fully electric vehicles (EVs) function under the widest range of driving and environmental circumstances and range of autonomy. To put it another way, an equal State of Charge (SOC) on two identical model EVs does not necessarily translate to the same distance traveled, as factors such as the battery's State of Health (SOH), the type of driver and even the route will affect how well the EVs operate. State of health (SOH) is the proportion of the battery's rated capacity to its maximal capacity as of the moment. It is a crucial index for describing the state of degradation in a battery for a pure electric vehicle and serves as a crucial benchmark for determining the retired battery's state of health and calculating the driving range. Estimating the state of health (SOH) of lithium-ion batteries is crucial for their safe and lifetime-optimized functioning, hence this is done using support vector regression. This paper presents Python code to implement this project.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Strategic Locations of Piezo for Maximum Voltage Generation in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The issues with combustion engine-powered automobiles can potentially be solved by Electric Vehicles (EVs). Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs), Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEVs), and Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles (FCEVs), all of which can successfully meet the needs of various categories of vehicle propulsion systems, would be the mainstay of the future transportation system. The considerable noise and vibration challenges that affect EVs and the efforts made by investigators to address them are covered in the current work. This paper discussed piezoelectric materials used for voltage generation on vibration panels in electric vehicles. The voltage generation due to the vibration of panels can be utilized in the source of electrical devices. The location of PZT on panels is essential so that voltage generation can be maximized. The panel is assumed to be fixed on all sides of the plate. The result of the above study is that the maximum voltage generated across PZT is at PZT located near fixed conditions compared to other locations.

articleTitle: Computer Network Security Evaluation Method Based on GABP Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Network security is the key to protect the computer network from malicious attacks and illegal access. Routine evaluation methods have some limitations, such as the failure to accurately reflect the dynamic changes and complex associations in the network. Therefore, this study proposed a GABP(Genetic Algorithm Back Propagation)model. First, network traffic data and security event data are collected for preprocessing and feature extraction. Then, the network traffic data is modeled and analyzed using the GABP model to identify potential security threats and vulnerabilities. Finally, the cybersecurity risks are evaluated and quantified based on the evaluation indicators. Through the experimental validation of the real network environment, the method of this study showed high accuracy and efficiency in detecting network security threats and vulnerabilities, and the test results of the four basic performances are close to 1. At the same time, this method can detect and respond to network security incidents in time, improve the protection ability of network security, has high practicability and feasibility, can effectively evaluate network security risks, and provide targeted security protection measures. Future studies could further refine and optimize the approach to the changing means of cybersecurity threats and attack.

articleTitle: Fake Reviews Detection Based on Sentiment Analysis Using ML Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Fake reviews carry substantial amount of significance for both the consumers and business owners and thus detection of fake reviews early helps to reduce the negative influential growth has become crucial after increased popularity of online shopping. Here, in this paper we propose machine learning approach by analysing both, the text and behaviour. A dataset of reviews was collected from various sites and it was labelled as Real or Fake. We then used various machine learning approaches like the Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression and Multinomial Naive Bayes for training and evaluation of the performance of our model. Results show that our method provides accuracy at par with the existing ones. Our method has its utilization by businesses and review platforms to detect and remove fake reviews which enhances trust in online reviews. The developed system achieves a high accuracy rate of 85% in identifying fake reviews, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving the reliability of online reviews.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Data Recognition Method Based on Deep Confidence Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This study aims to address the difficulty of identifying abnormal data samples in cloud platforms by constructing a new anomaly data recognition method based on deep confidence network ensemble learning algorithm. The new method utilizes ensemble learning algorithm to solve the problem of imbalanced samples during data operation, and improves the traditional ensemble algorithm using temporal key indicators, Finally, a new adaptive threshold voting algorithm is proposed to improve the classifier of ensemble learning algorithms and improve the generalization of algorithm performance. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has the highest sample accuracy of 99.52% and a recall rate of 99.29%. The accuracy of the improved algorithm is 0.85% higher than that of the support vector machine algorithm and 1.79<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> higher than that of the clustering algorithm. The improved algorithm has a higher accuracy than traditional algorithms and performs better in handling abnormal data.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Mathematical Reliability Modeling Based on Robustness Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In reliability modeling, there are uncertainties and fuzziness issues that require special methods and techniques for processing and analysis. In this paper, the fuzzy mathematical method based on robustness analysis is used to model reliability. The specific steps include problem description, determination of fuzzy variables and fuzzy sets, establishment of fuzzy relations and fuzzy rules, and fuzzy reasoning and analysis. Through experimental testing, the four test response times of the model in this article are 0.1s, 0.13s, 0.08s, and 0.11s, respectively, which are superior to the other two method models. This proves that the method proposed in this paper can effectively handle uncertainty and fuzziness problems, and improve the robustness and reliability of the system. Meanwhile, this method has high flexibility and scalability, and can adapt to the needs of different fields and application scenarios.

articleTitle: Secure Auditing with Encrypted Trace Logs in Multi-Cloud Storage Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Cloud computing revolutionizes the way resources are utilized, offering a platform where they can be dynamically allocated based on demand. This on-the-fly data processing and storage capability has led various providers to offer both free and premium storage solutions. However, with a multitude of providers in the market, accessing data scattered across them can be cumbersome. Hence, the emergence of multi-cloud storage management tools, which provide a unified interface for users to seamlessly access data without juggling between multiple providers. Though authenticated access safeguards data, maintaining its integrity requires oversight of user activities. This calls for the implementation of a Trace Log that meticulously records each action. Such logs, while crucial for auditing, are sensitive and can be vulnerable. To bolster their security, encryption techniques can be implemented, using unique user-specific keys. This not only enhances the log's security but also ensures controlled, authenticated access. A proposal for a robust, secure, and efficient system to manage and monitor data across multiple cloud platforms.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Quality Control Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Quality control mathematical model is a mathematical model based on the principle of statistical process control. Its application in modern quality management provides a scientific basis for quality management. The establishment process includes three parts: one is to make statistical analysis from a large number of actual data, the other is to make use of statistical data to establish a mathematical model. Based on support vector machine regression, logistic regression and neural network in machine learning, the mathematical modeling of quality control is studied in this paper. Experimental results show that machine learning based quality control mathematical model can achieve the highest accuracy of 94.4%. It is concluded that machine learning has high application potential in quality management and can provide a scientific basis for quality management.

articleTitle: Music Retrieval Algorithm Oriented to Support Vector Machine and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In order to solve the existing problems in the existing music retrieval system, this article introduces a music retrieval algorithm oriented to support vector machine and cloud computing, expresses the feature vector as the vector form of cloud computing, and performs data analysis and processing in cloud computing. In order to improve the accuracy of the retrieval system, the article adopts a new music retrieval method, which firstly performs feature extraction, then performs text retrieval, and finally uses support vector machines and cloud computing to analyze the data. The experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the retrieval accuracy of the music retrieval system, and its highest value is 95.6%. In the future, this method will become popular, and the majority of users will no longer have to worry about finding songs they have heard.

articleTitle: Sports Energy Consumption Estimation Model Based on Intelligent Algorithm and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, the application of intelligent algorithms and big data in sports science is becoming more and more extensive. This article aims to discuss the principles, methods and applications of the sports energy consumption estimation model based on intelligent algorithms and big data. This paper adopts the method of combining survey experiment and empirical research to discuss the estimation model of sports energy consumption based on intelligent algorithm and big data. Firstly, this paper introduces the existing sports energy consumption estimation models, and analyzes their advantages and disadvantages. Then, this paper elaborates the design and implementation process of the sports energy consumption estimation model based on intelligent algorithms and big data, including the model's architecture, algorithms and data sources. Finally, the paper summarizes the strengths and limitations of the model and points out corresponding measures. The experimental results show that the error rate of the intelligent algorithm estimation model for the energy consumption of fast walking sports is 10.1%, and the accuracy is relatively high.

articleTitle: Design of Tri Notched Ultrawideband Antenna Using U Slots and EBG Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: A circular ultra-wideband monopole antenna with triple band notch features has been designed and presented in this research article. The proposed antenna exhibits band elimination characteristics for three different narrowband applications, i.e. C-band satellite downlink band (3.7 GHz to 4.2 GHz), unlicensed WLAN frequency spectrum (5.47 GHz to 5.85 GHz), and downlink frequency spectrum (7.25 GHz to 7.75 GHz) for X-band satellite communication. Two U-shaped slots have been integrated into the radiating element with a mushroom nature of Electromagnetic Band Gap (EBG) structure of square shape positioned next to the feedline of the reference antenna. This integration produced the desired notching effect. The proposed design efficiently covers the ITU-specified UWB spectrum (3.1 – 10.6 GHz). The gains at the notched frequencies are well below the reference antenna and about −6 dB has been achieved at −3.95 GHz. The pass-band radiation characteristics indicate the usefulness of the design. The proposed antenna structure measures only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{0.28 \lambda}\times \boldsymbol{0.3\lambda}\times \boldsymbol{0.014 \lambda}$</tex> where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda$</tex> corresponds to the highest operating wavelength.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Open Loop and Closed Loop Control of Dc-Dc Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This study presents a comparative analysis of the performance of open-loop and closed-loop control systems applied to a DC-DC boost converter. DC-DC converters are integral components in various applications, such as power supplies for electronic devices, renewable energy systems, and electric vehicles. The choice between open-loop and closed-loop control for these converters significantly impacts their efficiency, stability, and transient response. The comparison between these two control strategies is conducted through rigorous simulations and experimental validations. The metrics for comparison include efficiency, load regulation, transient response, and overall system stability. By evaluating the trade-offs and performance differences, this study aims to provide valuable insights for selecting the most suitable control strategy in specific applications, ultimately contributing to the optimization of DC-DC boost converters for a wide range of industries.

articleTitle: The Application of Natural Language Processing Technology Based on Deep Learning in Japanese Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the era of artificial intelligence, with the rapid development of human beings, the study of natural language is also receiving increasing attention. This paper aims to explore the use of deep learning technology to detect and predict emotional tendency of artificial neural network models. Firstly, the text expression capability based on feature extraction and classifier construction will be introduced. Secondly, the word vector adaptive method used in the experimental process will be explained in detail, which can achieve semantic computation and emotion mining. Finally, we will also propose a fusion function strategy to mark the content of the article, and build a natural language processing system based on this strategy. At the same time, we will test the performance of the system. The test results show that the adaptability of the system can reach 74% at the lowest and 79% at the highest, which can show that the analysis technology of the system can meet the basic requirements. Through these researches and explorations, we will be able to better understand and demonstrate the importance of natural language processing in modern society. The application of deep learning in Japanese emotion analysis has achieved some research results. By using the deep learning method, we can train large-scale Japanese text, learn the language feature representation, and realize the understanding and analysis of text emotion. Deep learning can improve the accuracy of Japanese emotion analysis by using the technology of word embedding and language model. In addition, deep learning can also be applied to other natural language processing tasks, such as machine translation and question answering systems, and bring better results to these tasks. In the future, we can look forward to the further research and application of deep learning in the field of Japanese emotion analysis.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction on Fish Dataset with Different Machine Learning Algorithms Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Classification of fish is a complex task in the current situation exhibited by the great diversity of available species, even though it is used in agricultural and commercial sectors. In this work, the data is classified with the Supervised Machine Learning algorithms such as K-Nearest Neighbour, Naïve Bayes, and Decision Tree, observing the results before and after applying dimensionality reduction techniques PCA, LDA, and Truncate SVD. One of the well-known dimensionality reduction techniques Linear Discriminant Analysis LDA achieves the highest accuracy for K-NN, Naïve Bayes 93.7%, and Decision Tree 96.8%.

articleTitle: Election Forecasting with Machine Learning and Sentiment Analysis: Karnataka 2023
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Data science is rapidly transforming the political sphere, enabling more informed and data- driven electoral processes. The ensemble machine model which is made up of Random Forest Classifier, Gradient Boosting Classifier, and Voting Classifier, introduced in this paper makes use of machine learning methods and sentiment analysis to correctly forecast the results of the Karnataka state elections in 2023. Election features such as winning party, runner- up party, district name, winning margin, and voting turnout are used to evaluate the effectiveness of different machine learning paradigms. Similarly, it also makes use of sentiment analysis through party tweet and public reactions for further breaking down reliance upon past elections data alone. This study demonstrates that using both past historical records and current public opinion yields precise predictions about how electable leaders are. This reduces reliance on a historical dataset. The experimented results shows that, how machine learning and sentiment analysis can predict election results and provide useful data for election decision making. We compared various machine learning models in this study, including logistic regression, Grid SearchCV, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting Classifier, and ensemble model. With an accuracy of 85%, we demonstrated that our ensemble model outperformed machine models such as XGBoost and Gradient Boosting Classifier. It also offers a novel method for predictive analysis.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis of Dynamic Economic Environment Scheduling Problem Based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Differential evolution algorithm is a common optimization algorithm with extensive applications in solving dynamic economic environment scheduling problems. The dynamic and uncertainty of economic activities make it difficult to achieve efficient resource scheduling and economic benefit maximization in the dynamic economic environment. In this paper, we study dynamic economic environment scheduling based on a differential evolution algorithm. First, the background and significance of dynamic economic environment scheduling are expounded. Then we analyze the key factors and optimization strategies of this method in the optimization process. Finally, the power generation cost results of DE algorithm are 2.4805,2.4653,2.4196 and 2.5016 (* 106$), which are the lowest cost compared with other algorithms. The experimental results show that the optimization method of dynamic economic environment scheduling problem based on differential evolution algorithm can solve the problem effectively, and has high optimization effect and application value. The method can not only ensure the economy, but also adapt to the change of dynamic environment, with high practicability and operability.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of Tourism Consumption Behavior Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The development of the economy promotes the unprecedented prosperity of the tourism industry. This paper analyzes the application of big data on the current online travel platform, and discusses how to use data to guide market decisions. On this basis, this paper attempts to adopt a more scientific theoretical system of big data marketing, and use it to guide the marketing and communication strategies of the online tourism industry. Therefore, the mode of big data guiding enterprise tourism consumption behavior in the Internet environment is discussed from point to surface. In 2018, China's online travel transaction volume was 150 billion yuan, and the penetration rate of Internet travel was 10%. Under the development trend of “big data + tourism”, this paper can provide certain theoretical and practical guidance for China's tourism marketing activities. At the same time, it can also allow people to use tourism big data to achieve precise marketing under the background of big data, thereby improving the quality of tourism services and tourism management capabilities.

articleTitle: Text Segmentation and Transliteration Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Reading text from images is crucial for understanding image content. This can range from scanned documents with predominant text, video frames with captions, or photos with naturally occurring text. Recognizing text in images can be used in various ways, such as indexing multimedia, assisting drivers by recognizing signs, aiding visually impaired individuals with scene descriptions, or identifying vehicles via license plates. The surge in affordable digital cameras and high-quality mobile phone cameras has intensified the focus on extracting text from photographs in the field of computer vision. While there are many OCR (Optical Character Recognition) systems, the preliminary step is to segment the text from the image. This project aims to extract and segment text from natural images, process it through an OCR, and enhance its usability through transliteration. It aims to enhance image-based text recognition by segmenting text from natural images, processing it with OCR, and amplifying its utility through transliteration, catering to diverse applications like multimedia indexing and aiding the visually impaired.

articleTitle: Electronic Sensor Multi-Modal Slam Algorithm Based on Information Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: When the multi-mode electronic sensor based on information fusion works, it will be interfered by various noises in the process of data acquisition and transmission, and the signal will appear nonlinear distortion. Therefore, this paper needs to compensate the input analog quantity to a certain extent. In this paper, multiple sensors such as lidar and camera are used to obtain environmental information. These sensors measure the environment, resulting in a series of data points. These data points are input into the information fusion system for processing to obtain a high-precision environment model. The information fusion system uses the SLAM method to estimate and correct the measurement results of each sensor, so as to obtain a more accurate environmental model. This paper describes the sensor and the algorithm used in it, and obtained the data through case analysis and multi-modal experiments. The experimental results show that the error of the multi-modal SLAM algorithm is reduced to 1.1 %, and the accuracy is 98.9%. This has a great effect on the reconstruction variable and parameter extraction accuracy in the target environment.

articleTitle: Design of a Deep Learning-Based General Fruit Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent years, agriculture has developed towards intelligence, and the recognition and picking of mature fruits and melons are gradually being replaced by intelligent machinery. Therefore, this paper takes fruits and melons in the natural environment as the research object and conducts research on fruit and melons recognition technology based on Deep learning(DL). The primary research focus of this paper can be summarized as follows: firstly, aiming at the limitation of CNN training time being too long, a recognition method of melon and fruit image based on YOLOv3 algorithm was designed. Due to the normalization characteristics of Darknet-53, the Darknet-37 feature extraction network has been redesigned to improve detection speed while ensuring algorithm accuracy, meeting the real-time requirements of picking robots for target fruit detection. Finally, comparative experiments have shown that the improved YOLOv3 algorithm has an mAP value of over 86% in citrus maturity target recognition, indicating high accuracy.

articleTitle: Responsive Design and Adaptability of Building Skin Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: As the first interface between the building and the external environment, the building skin is a key element of architectural design. In the context of the information age, traditional design patterns can no longer adapt to rapidly changing design requirements. Based on this, this paper attempts to use deep learning algorithms to conduct research on responsive design and adaptability of building skins, and applies this method to actual cases to realize the automatic generation and adjustment of building skin responsive design through artificial intelligence algorithms. The experimental results show that the monthly energy consumption of the building can be reduced to 6384 kWh by using the deep learning algorithm for the responsive and adaptive design of the building skin. The purpose of this article is to explore the responsive design method of building skin based on deep learning algorithm, and to provide a new idea for its application in urban and natural climate conditions.

articleTitle: A Simplified Design of Fast Error Correction Module Using Reed-Solomon Code
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: A Forward Error Correction (FEC) module realized in hardware on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is having more significance in the practical control applications. This is due to its ability to process the data (encoding and decoding) much faster through FPGA and able to overcome the limitations of data transfer. But the real challenge in such a design is the run time reconfiguration. Lot of researches happening on this issue and there is no standard reference available. Also, there is no flexibility in the existing software solutions. Considering this, in this work, the authors were tried to perform a basic software implementation of FEC module using Reed Solomon (RS) code on a custom made system-on-chip with a soft core processor followed by the RTL level implementation of RS code which can be dynamically controlled. To achieve faithful data transfer between two terminals, two NIOS II SOCs (System on Chip) were built on FPGAs. For the implementation, Altera Cyclone III FPGA starter board was used. Quartus II 10.1 Design Software with NIOS II Embedded Design Suite adopted for configuring the FPGA. The performance of the developed model is verified by monitoring the content message bits before and after corruption of data at the receiver terminal. A comparative study was carried out between hardware and software implementations.

articleTitle: Computer Communication Security Evaluation System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The computer communication security evaluation system is one of the current research hotspots. Through artificial intelligence technologies such as machine learning and deep learning, communication data can be analyzed and processed, thereby improving the guarantee ability of communication security. This study conducted in- depth research on computer communication security evaluation systems based on artificial intelligence, mainly using a combination of literature review and experimental analysis methods to summarize key technologies in feature extraction and selection, neural network models, dataset quality and quantity, etc. This study found that feature extraction and selection are one of the key technologies in computer communication security evaluation systems based on artificial intelligence. The quality and quantity of datasets also had a significant impact on the performance and accuracy of the system. The accuracy, recall, and Fl values of this experiment were 89.75%, 90.75%, and 88.25%, respectively. The computer communication security evaluation system based on artificial intelligence can analyze and process different security events, effectively improving the guarantee ability of communication security.

articleTitle: Design of Rural Ambient Intelligence Monitoring System Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The rural information monitoring system based on wireless sensor network (WSN) technology can be precisely used for monitoring the rural environment. In a data-centric WSN, to ensure accurate information transmission, channel equalization technology is needed to solve this problem. Optimizing routing protocols can balance network energy consumption and prevent important nodes from being consumed too early. Reasonable node deployment can not only reduce energy consumption but also promote network communication. Therefore, in order to improve the communication quality of WSN, this paper used ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm to improve the communication quality of WSN, and designed a rural ambient intelligence monitoring system according to this algorithm. Finally, data reliability and communication quality tests were conducted on the intelligent monitoring system. The experimental results showed that the error between the air humidity collected by the rural ambient intelligence monitoring platform and the manually sampled air humidity was not more than 0.5%, the error of measuring the PM2.5 content in the air was not more than 0.5mcg, and the network packet loss rate was always below 5%. The results of many tests showed that the system runs stably and has high monitoring accuracy, which can meet the needs of rural ambient intelligence monitoring.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vitiligo Disease Diagnosis Expert System Using Fuzzy AHP and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The disease Vitiligo causes the skin's color to deteriorate. This fading can affect any part of the body's skin in addition to the hair, eyes, and inner corners of the mouth. In this work, an expert system for Vitiligo diagnosis was developed to make it simpler for patients to determine the severity of their Vitiligo. The challenge this research work is how to employ the fuzzy AHP and fuzzy Topsis Method and fuzzy logic to develop an expert system to ease the diagnosis of Vitiligo. Fuzzy logic is one method that uses certain stages. Use case, sequence, and activity diagrams were used as a system design tool during the system's structured approach to construction.

articleTitle: Gyrator-Based Frequency Tuning Circuit: A Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Gyrators are fifth passive, linear, lossless, two- port electrical network elements. The present work simulates and analyse the performance of a passive tuning circuit (PTC) and a gyrator-based tuning circuit (GTC). The PTC and GTC have been evaluated utilizing Simulation Programme with Integrated Circuit Emphasis in frequency and time domains, and Monte Carlo analysis. The gyrator-based circuit exhibited better performance in terms of Q-factor. Both tuning circuits showed comparable results and illustrates emulated inductance in gyrator circuit replicates the characteristics of passive inductance. Impedance of the GTC was notably lower compared to that of the PTC facilitating efficient voltage transfer, especially at resonance frequency. Monte Carlo analysis highlights varying component values within tolerance in PTC and GTC resulting in shift in resonance frequency and lower Q- factor. The GTC illustrated narrow bandwidth, higher Q-factor than PTC, and stability over the resonant frequency range, making it ideal for tuning circuits that reject undesired signals.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Music Information Big Data Storage and Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: At present, the progress of Internet technology has made the music recommendation system develop rapidly, and the online music platform has gradually become the first choice for people to listen to music. Then in the field of music analysis, this text conducts in-depth research on similarity calculation methods for music analysis models of various data types, in order to draw more accurate conclusions. According to the method framework and research methods proposed in this text, we have successfully constructed a music data analysis, retrieval and storage platform, which provides comprehensive services for music analysis and retrieval. Through this platform, the information or resources that users are interested in can be effectively found from massive data, and the relevant music resources that users need can be quickly and accurately located. The score dataset are 0.69 and 0.62 respectively. Compared with existing platforms, the method proposed in this text shows remarkable effectiveness and practicality in practice, which is fully proved.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models Based Crop Recommendation and Plant Disease Identification for Real Time Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The production of crops contributes significantly to the economic health of every country. One of the most crucial elements of maintaining a country with a developed agricultural sector is plant disease identification. An agricultural sector that is healthy and productive and that doesn't waste money or other resources requires the quick and effective diagnosis of plant diseases. Various useful technologies to solve global challenges have been developed with the aid of machine learning. The use of several ML algorithms can help solve the agriculture problem. The creation of a website that incorporates both a crop recommendation system and a plant disease identification system is one of the two goals of this essay. The datasets might be accessed by anyone online. The dataset is trained once the characteristics required for Task 1 are retrieved using five distinct algorithms: logistic regression, decision tree, support vector machine (SVM), multilayer perceptron, and random forest. In suggested machine learning models, random forest exceeds all other techniques, achieving an accuracy rate of 99.92%.

articleTitle: Application of Random Forest Algorithm in Agricultural Meteorological Disaster Statistics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Currently, meteorological departments simply categorize agrometeorological disasters into general meteorological disasters, major meteorological disasters and extreme meteorological disasters. When using big data techniques to analyze and access disaster classification data, it becomes clear that disasters are closely related to economic losses, population and crop damage, and must follow certain rules. Agrometeorological databases on natural hazards contain a large amount of data. These data contain many patterns and rules of research interest that can be used to prevent disasters and reduce economic losses. Random forest algorithm is a method used for data classification. It can effectively solve the problems in traditional artificial weather forecasting models and provide new ideas. In this paper, we will introduce two basic models, random forest and forward distribution, and discuss their applications in weather disaster prediction, early warning and other aspects. Meanwhile, its advantages and disadvantages are analyzed and its applicability is compared. Finally, the measured and actual loss rates (i.e., probability density functions) and standard deviations under several sets of different parameters are given through numerical examples. From the above results, it can be concluded that the model obtained by using the above method can classify the data, and the Random Forest algorithm outperforms the traditional algorithm in terms of average prediction accuracy, Random Forest classification error rate, inconsistency index and so on.

articleTitle: Design of Information Learning Platform Management System in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of modern technology and the continuous promotion of IT, IT has been widely applied in modern performing arts. Information management has become the most practical and effective method and means in the management of performance art training. However, with the exponential growth of various data volumes, the demand for computing and processing capabilities, as well as speed, for massive amounts of data and information is also increasing. This paper proposed a platform based network security solution, established a complete network security policy system, and conducted experiments on users based on three different Collaborative filtering recommendation algorithms. The results showed that the Jaccard-CF algorithm proposed in this paper had the highest mean absolute error value of 0.752, and its prediction results were more accurate than the other two types of algorithms.

articleTitle: Neural Networks in Recruitment: Trends and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: A thorough bibliometric analysis of 464 academic publications published between 1985 and 2023 is presented in this study to analyse current trends and potential future directions for neural networks in recruiting. It looks at publishing patterns, well-known publications, and notable contributors to this area-authors, institutions, and nations. The findings help researchers choose credible journals for publishing by offering insightful information on major research themes and illuminating developing areas within this domain. Researchers need to investigate the use of neural networks in new recruiting fields, such as prejudice reduction, diversity and inclusion, ethical considerations, and privacy issues. Future research might focus on using neural networks in group decision-making procedures and the fusion of neural networks with other cutting-edge technologies like machine learning and natural language processing.

articleTitle: Application Evaluation of Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm in Organic Pollution Control Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Pollution control is a complex system engineering, and in order to truly achieve comprehensive environmental management and protection, it is necessary to do a good job in controlling pollution at the source. However, due to historical reasons and economic development levels, many places still have serious pollution phenomena. This paper mainly analyzes and discusses the problem of organic pollution, uses particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to screen pollutants, and combines BP (back propagation) neural network to establish a pollution source prediction system. According to the selected optimal solution, a new mathematical model is constructed, which can better serve environmental protection, improve work efficiency, and reduce operating costs, It has high practical value. Comparing the PSO algorithm model with the BP neural network model in the treatment of organic pollutants, experimental data shows that the application effect of the PSO algorithm is more ideal, the prediction results are more accurate, and the pollutant removal rate has also increased by about 3.53%, providing new ideas and methods for environmental science and engineering exploration. The research results show that applying PSO algorithm to organic pollution control prediction systems can achieve certain results. By optimizing model parameters or control strategy parameters, the accuracy and control effectiveness of organic pollutant prediction can be improved. The PSO algorithm can also be used to optimize risk assessment models and improve the accuracy of organic pollutant risk assessment.

articleTitle: Stock Closing Price Prediction Using Deep Learning, TensorFlow, and Keras
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Stock market forecasting is a particularly difficult undertaking because it is dynamic, non-linear, and dependent on a number of factors. This model helps the ones who are interested in the stock market and wants to gain profit from it. By comparing the proposed methodology value to the actual value and utilizing the evaluation metrics RMSE and MSE, the model is put to the test. The goal is to have a model that is able to predict the closing price of the stock by evaluating the previous stock prices which will help the investors while buying or selling the stocks. The objective is to build a Deep learning model capable of accurately predicting Stock closing prices, identifying the key features that significantly impact stock prices and providing visualization by improving supervised learning. The proposed method will utilize a supervised learning approach, RNN to predict stock closing prices.

articleTitle: Elliptic Seizure Detection on EEG Signals Using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Many screening methods have been analyzed by employing the modalities of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Electroencephalography (EEG) to diagnose epileptic seizures. Deep Learning (DL) is a branch of artificial intelligence, which is a broad field. Conventional DL could only perform as well as people who made the features by hand. On the other hand, DL fully automates both feature extraction and categorization. EEG is an often employed and noteworthy method for assisting in the diagnosis of epilepsy and examining the movement of the human brain. Since EEG signals are non-stationary, a patient's seizure patterns will change during various recording sessions. This study uses a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) model to detect seizures and brain tumours. Preprocessing the EEG signal, extracting preictal features, hyper-optimization using Mayfly Optimization (MO). Long-term EEG recordings from the EEG and ABIDE fMRI datasets are used in the evaluation. Many returned features are used by the Bi-LSTM model, such as frequency domain and temporal information between extracted EEG channels prior to classification. The proposed Bi-LSTM accomplishes a 99.12% accuracy rate, 98.25% precision, 99.06% recall, and 98.53% f1-measure which is superior when related to existing models.

articleTitle: Rice Leaf Disease Identification Using Adam Optimizer Based Modified Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Recently, one of the grain-based crops that is farmed the most is rice, which is important to the agricultural sector. Furthermore, rice is a significant crop that is consumed by almost half of the global population. However, biotic and abiotic elements including bacteria, viruses, pests, soil fertility, and so forth have an impact on agricultural production. Early disease identification saves farmers time, increases crop yield, and guards against production loss in rice plants. The rice fields used for cultivation are the source of the rice leaf image dataset. The three disease classes that made up the data acquisition were Brown Spot, Bacterial Blight, and Leaf Blast. The ultimate goal of this proposed study is to improve rice leaf detection and classification performance. Thus, using a deep learning approach, this study presented an Adam Optimizer (AO) to carry out an efficient classification of rice leaf disease. Moreover, rice leaf disease detection and classification involve the use of Transfer Learning in conjunction with Inception V3 architecture. The Modified Differential Evolution Algorithm (MDEA) technique is used to determine the transfer learning approach's optimal learning rate. Finally, the proposed AO-MDEA shows better performance metrics in terms of accuracy (98.74%), precision (99.04%), recall (99.12%) and F1-score (99.15%) respectively.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Cross Layer with Fuzzy Chaotic Whale Wolf Optimization-Based Efficient Routing for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: An efficient clustering and routing of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) is a critical challenge, with a significant impact on Quality of Service (QoS) performance. In this research, a Cross-Layer-based Fuzzy Chaotic Whale Wolf Optimisation (CL-FCWWO) is proposed to improve the performance in WSNs. The K-medoids with Improved Artificial-Bee-Colony (K-IABC)-based energy-efficient clustering and the routing protocol is utilized to address the power asymmetry issue in WSNs. Cross-layer routing is suggested to reduce network transmission latency and power consumption. The MATLAB is used to construct this approach and compared the results to other techniques. The suggested CL-FCWWO outperforms in terms of energy consumption, throughput, and network lifetime. These results are validated by comparisons with existing routing algorithms such as Cross-layer based Opportunistic Routing Protocol (CORP), Cross-Layer Harris-Hawks-Optimization-algorithm (CL-HHO) and Adaptive Sailfish Optimisation (ASFO). From the results, it showed that proposed CL-FCWWO algorithm performed better than CORP, ASFO and CL-HHO methods, showing its effectiveness in improving WSNs performance.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Deep Learning Pretrained Image Classifiation Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is revolutionized in the field of computer vision, with the high accuracy and capability to learn features from raw data. In this research work focused on a comparative analysis of two popular CNN architectures, VGG16 and VGG19. The CIFAR dataset consists of 60,000 images, each with a resolution of 32x32 and it's belong to one of the 10 classes. Experimental results are compared with VGG16 and VGG19 in terms of their accuracy and training time, and to identify any differences in their ability to learn features from the CIFAR-10 dataset. The results of this research can aid in directing the choice of appropriate architectures for image classification tasks as well as the advantages of optimisation strategies for enhancing the efficiency of deep learning models. In order to enhance the performance of these structures, more optimisation methods and datasets may be investigated in subsequent research.

articleTitle: Precision Dynamic Engineering Measurement Technology Using Internet of Things and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the development of construction industry, the traditional EM technology can no longer meet the fine requirements of engineering construction, and more intelligent technology is needed to solve the problem of high-precision and demanding measurement and control in engineering construction, and precision dynamic(PD) engineering measurement(EM) technology is born. The technology integrates mechanical processing, electronics, measurement and other disciplines, making the service scope of precision EM more and more extensive. In this paper, the PD EM system is designed jointly with Internet of Things technology and cloud computing(CC), and the system builds a CC platform for engineering structure monitoring, which can monitor the state of engineering structure and monitor construction deformation. Meanwhile, this paper analyzes its application in measurement control and proves that the technology has good measurement advantages. It is found that the introduction of the Internet of Things and cloud computing can effectively improve the system security of engineering measurement systems.

articleTitle: System Management Model Based on ABC-ACO Algorithm under the Background of Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the digital economy, the need to manage complex systems is increasing day by day, and traditional management methods are often unable to fully adapt to this challenge. Therefore, this research proposes a system management model based on the ABC-ACO algorithm, which aims to optimize decision-making and resource allocation and improve system performance and efficiency. In this paper, the ABC-ACO algorithm is used as the main optimization tool. The algorithm combines artificial bee colony algorithm (ABC) and ant colony optimization algorithm (ACO), and has the characteristics of adaptive search and iterative optimization. Through experimental tests, the accuracy rate of the algorithm in this paper is 92% at the highest and 86% at the lowest. The system management model based on the ABC- ACO algorithm performs well in the context of the digital economy. By optimizing decision-making and resource allocation, the model can improve the performance and efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Stock Price Volatility Prediction in Financial Big Data on XGBoost and ARIMA Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Stock financial market is a typical incomplete information economy. Price volatility is an important characteristic of the stock market, it reflects the uncertainty of the market, but also reflects the degree of market activity. With the continuous development of digitalization and BD (Big Data) technology in the financial industry, stock price volatility prediction and analysis can help investors better understand market dynamics and formulate more scientific investment strategies. XGBoost (eXtreme Gradient Boosting) and ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) models have powerful visualization capabilities and real-time performance, enabling rapid and accurate acquisition of market data. Therefore, this paper uses these two ways to describe the stock price volatility, aiming at improving the ability of stock price prediction. This paper mainly uses the experimental investigation method, case verification and comparison method, through the design of support vector machine-assisted XGBoost and ARIMA models, to get the stock market of Shenzhen and Shanghai 300 index, compare the prediction level of various models, and get relevant suggestions. Experimental results show that the recall rate of XGBoost model with support vector machine is 0.95, and the accuracy is 0.98. Therefore, adding intelligent algorithms can effectively improve the accuracy of stock price volatility prediction.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Early Warning Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article proposes a financial risk warning method based on big data analysis, aiming to discover and predict potential financial risks in a timely manner by analyzing and mining a large amount of financial data. This method utilizes advanced big data analysis techniques internal and external information of financial institutions, in order to identify key factors and trends that may trigger risks. Through experimental verification, this method can effectively alert financial risks, improve the risk management level and risk prevention ability of financial institutions. Experiments have also shown that the financial risk warning capability based on big data can be improved by 95%.

articleTitle: Detection System of Computer Network Virus Password Algorithm Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and the Internet, computer viruses have become a serious threat to computer information security. Analyzing computer virus password algorithms can help people better prevent viruses and malicious attacks. Therefore, in the big data environment, the computer network virus password algorithm detection system based on big data has become a research hotspot. This paper mainly studies the working principle of the computer network virus password algorithm detection system based on big data, analyzes the main functions of the system, and introduces its main functional modules in detail. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the computer network virus password algorithm detection system based on big data are verified by the experimental results. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy and detection efficiency of the system reached the highest 95.3 % and 95.9%, respectively, which has high reliability and practicability. The system can effectively analyze the password algorithm of computer viruses and detect potential virus threats in a timely manner. This is of great significance to improve the protection capabilities of computer information security and protect users' data and privacy.

articleTitle: 3D Scene Object Perception Algorithm Based on Computer Vision Technology Based on Multi-View
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Traditional single-viewpoint algorithms have limitations in target perception in 3D scenes, while computer vision technology based on multi-viewpoints can provide more comprehensive and accurate target perception capabilities. This study proposes a multi-view computer vision technology based object perception algorithm for 3D scenes. In this paper, image data from multiple angles is used for target positioning and shape reconstruction, and the accuracy of target position and shape is improved by combining information from different angles. Synthesize information from multiple angles to obtain more comprehensive and richer target semantic information. Through experiments and evaluations on real 3D scene datasets, the algorithm in this paper achieves remarkable research results. After experimental testing, the recall rate of the algorithm in this paper ranges from 81% to 88%. Compared with traditional single-viewpoint algorithms, multi-viewpoint-based algorithms show higher accuracy and comprehensiveness in object localization, shape reconstruction and semantic understanding.

articleTitle: Forward Vision Measurement System for Automotive Drivers Based on Laser and Machine Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article designs a forward vision measurement system for automobile drivers based on laser and machine vision technology, which takes the forward vision of automobile drivers as the main indicator to judge the active safety of automobiles. A good forward vision of automobile drivers is of great significance to ensure safe driving of vehicles. In order to verify the system's use of computers for communication with coordinate measuring machines, real-time collection and analysis of data at measurement points, and establishment of mathematical calculation models, it can significantly improve work efficiency and ensure the accuracy and consistency of test data. The results indicate that the system can accurately measure the driver's front field of view and has high testing efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Enhancement of DGS Based Planar Antenna for UWB Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Designing a single planar antenna capable of resonating at multiple frequencies poses a significant challenge for antenna designers. The research study proposes a centre-fed microstrip patch antenna (MPA) to address this issue. By incorporating changes on the top radiating side and the ground, the antenna's overall effectiveness is enhanced drastically. The proposed ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna operates at a central frequency of 3.5 GHz and exhibits resonance at six frequencies, including 3/4.1/4.7/7/7.7 and 9.4 GHz. The antenna achieves a notable gain of 5.365 dB across a bandwidth of 1.3086 GHz. Drawing from the significant enhancements in gain (76.39%) and bandwidth (435.65<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), it can be concluded with certainty that the performance of the microstrip antenna is closely associated with the dimensions of the patch and the ground. Ansys HFSS has been used for the design and performance evaluation.

articleTitle: An Inception Architecture with Transfer Learning for Apple Plant Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Recently, Agriculture is a major factor in the continuation of human life on Earth. An accurate evaluation of plant diseases is crucial since using the incorrect chemicals to treat them could make the viruses more resistant to the plants they infect. Apple leaf mites and litura moth are the two most prevalent apple leaf diseases that have a detrimental impact on apple quality and productivity. Several researchers have proposed and applied a range of Deep Learning (DL) algorithms to diagnose diseases affecting apple leaves. The procedure of diagnosing and treating diseases that harm a plant's leaves by hand will take longer. Disease classification and detection can be accomplished with the usage of DL frameworks. The apple leaf disease dataset that was gathered from the Kaggle repository is subjected to the Inception model. Apple leaf disease detection uses Inception-based models in this research study. The suggested approach uses deep learning model to simplify the classification of apple leaf disease. With the apple leaf disease dataset, the suggested approach exhibits the highest validation accuracy of 99.03% which is better than the existing method.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Remora Optimization Algorithm for Efficient Routing in Cognitive Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Cognitive Wireless Sensor Networks (CWSNs) are exposed to severe energy constraints, requiring investigation into solutions for extended network lifetimes. Radio Frequency Wireless Energy Harvesting (RFWEH) has proven its ability to efficiently mitigate these limits. However, the dynamic nature of many CWSN applications, influenced by node mobility, causes issues as network topologies changes. A unique Multi-Objective Remora Optimization Algorithm (MROA) is developed to handle the combination of energy harvesting and node mobility. MROA is designed for mobility-aware CWSNs and incorporates energy harvesting effortlessly. To choose cluster heads, the protocol applies an R-factor parameter that incorporates residual node energy, residual node data, and node speed with appropriate weighting. As a result, the MROA framework improves the network's energy performance, which leads to an extended using lifetime. When compared to existing methods namely RMAC-M, R-MAC, and WORP the suggested method performed well in the 500 rounds. It achieved in terms, Alive nodes -3400, Throughput - 170.57 kbps and Delay - 45.00 seconds respectively.

articleTitle: Concrete Crack Image Recognition System Based on Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Concrete crack detection is an important link in the construction of water conservancy projects, which has a significant impact on dam safety. Therefore, it is particularly important to study a fast, accurate and economical crack identification system. Bayesian algorithm is a probabilistic algorithm based on prior information, which has a high recognition accuracy. The article first preprocesses the concrete crack image, and then uses the Bayesian algorithm to identify cracks on the processed image. The system can realize real-time and automatic identification of concrete cracks, and can display the identification results through the human-computer interaction interface. The test results show that the highest recognition accuracy of the system can reach 91.6%. This method provides an effective solution for crack detection and monitoring. The high recognition accuracy achieved in the test further verifies the effectiveness of the system. Future research can focus on expanding the system's ability to handle more complex crack patterns and improving the efficiency of its large-scale applications.

articleTitle: Mobile-Web Based Electronic Health Records System for ICU Patient Management in Heart Hospital
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Heart disease is a major public health issue that requires timely and accurate diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of patients. However, many healthcare providers and patients face challenges in accessing and updating health information, especially in resource-limited settings. This paper presents the design, development, and evaluation of a novel Mobile-Web-based electronic health records system (MWEHRS) that leverages the advantages of both mobile and web technologies to provide a user-friendly, secure, and scalable system for patient management in heart diseases. Through this research a real system has been implemented in National Heart Foundation Hospital, Bangladesh. MWEHRS allows healthcare providers and patients to access and update health information using any device with an internet connection, such as smartphones, tablets, or computers. The developed system also integrates various features and functionalities to support the diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of heart disease patients. The system provides automation to calculate some parameters and thus relieves the attending nurses from doing so. The developed system enables doctors to watch patient status in real time and take decisions with ease both during and after the course of therapy.
