articleTitle: Jotter: An Approach to Summarize the Formal Online Meeting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This paper examines various meeting summarising techniques. It also presents a hybridised technique for meeting summarization that combines abstractive and extractive techniques. Text extraction from meetings is accomplished in two ways: audio during the meeting and text recognition from the screen. These extracted texts are then compiled to create a meeting summary. In contrast to extractive text summarising, which concatenates essential sentences from paragraphs, abstractive text summarization focuses on providing a coherent summary of the given content. The maj ority of recent progress on abstractive summarization has been using RNN or Recurrent Neural Networks, although RNN-based algorithms fail when dealing with long sequences. This paper proposes hybridizing these two methods sequentially for meeting summarization to create a better overall summary of the meeting. This research endeavour seeks to convert conference video and audio into text documents and then run our hybridised text summarizer model on them. The result is a summarised text document that the various stakeholders, whether present at the conference or not, could utilise for rapid and concise reference. It will help the people who are not been able to attend the meeting can get the main points discussed in the meeting through summary.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of English Teaching Effect Based on Neural Network Algorithm and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The optimize the analysis of support vector machines in response to the problem that traditional English teaching models cannot solve the accuracy and efficiency of student English teaching effectiveness evaluation, nor can they meet the requirements of English teaching effectiveness evaluation. Firstly, a multi-indicator English teaching effectiveness evaluation system with teachers and students as the main body was constructed using relevant theories, and the indicators were divided according to the data requirements of English teaching effectiveness evaluation indicators to reduce support vector machines in interference factors. Then, the neural network algorithm is used to solve the optimal solution of the kernel function parameters and regularization parameters of the support vector machine, forming a support vector machine scheme, and the support vector machine results are comprehensively analyzed. MATLAB simulation shows that neural network algorithms and support vector machines have the best evaluation accuracy and short evaluation time for English teaching effectiveness under certain evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Application of Adaboost Algorithm in Enterprise Financial Risk Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Adaboost (Adaptive Boosting) algorithm is an ensemble learning method, which combines multiple weak classifiers to build a strong classifier, and improves the performance of the model iteratively. It is widely used in various fields, including enterprise financial risk analysis models. Therefore, this article used the Adaboost algorithm to study the financial risk analysis model, with the aim of improving the accuracy of risk prediction. This paper mainly used the method of experiment and algorithm comparison to compare the performance of Adaboost algorithm, decision tree algorithm and Logistic regression model. The experimental data showed that the recall rate of high-risk categories was 0.91, which means that the success rate of the AdaBoost model in predicting high-risk companies was 91%; the specificity was 0.902, which was 90.2% of the predicted risk-free enterprises in the model. The F1 value reached 0.818, indicating that the model performs well in predicting risk categories.

articleTitle: Application of PRT Technology in Rehabilitation Intelligent Training System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Since ancient times, childhood education has been crucial. Group A received PRT intervention training, while Group B received traditional rehabilitation training. The evaluation results using the Autism Behavior Checklist (ABC) showed that the average score of Group A was around 69.74 points, while Group B was around 73.4 points. This proved that child rehabilitation training under PRT technology has significant advantages in enhancing children's social adaptability, promoting motor function recovery, and significantly improving the intelligence level of autistic children, thereby alleviating their psychological anxiety and depression, which is beneficial for their physical and mental health development. PTR technology is an excellent auxiliary tool in the intelligent training system for children's rehabilitation. It can not only alleviate the physical discomfort symptoms of children, but also enable patients to acquire better learning abilities, injecting new impetus into promoting the scientific direction of children's rehabilitation.

articleTitle: Accounting Intelligent Monitoring System Based on Data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the continuous increase of the number of risk points in accounting, how to improve accounting risk control has become an urgent problem to be studied and solved under the new situation. This paper designs an intelligent monitoring system for accounting risks. In the system analysis and design stage, this paper builds an intelligent accounting information management system based on SAP HANA to reduce accounting risks through real-time monitoring. In the implementation phase of the accounting risk monitoring system, an accounting risk monitoring model based on CNN-LSTM was established. Experimental analysis shows that the accuracy, accuracy, recall and F1 values of the CNN-LSTM accounting risk monitoring model are higher than traditional machine learning algorithms such as SVM and K-mean clustering analysis. Therefore, the accounting risk intelligent monitoring system constructed in this paper has stronger predictive analysis capabilities and can break through the bottleneck of traditional business intelligence systems.

articleTitle: Model Order Reduction Using Cuckoo Search Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: An optimization technique is introduced to reduce a system of high order by using Cuckoo Search Optimization (CSO). The numerator and denominator coefficient parameters of proposed system are defined by Cuckoo search optimization (CSO). In this paper, numerical examples of linear time invariant system are illustrated and proposed method efficacy is tested and compared to Eigen spectrum-factor division analysis, hybrid balanced truncation method, pole clustering with Routh-Pade Approximation, multi objective harmony search and other relative techniques. CSO technique provides an optimal order reduction model and minimizes the integral square error. The establishment of satisfactory result of proposed method for higher order model displayed by step response and Bode diagram and better perfection with minimized ISE error related to comparable newly developed mixed technology is obtained. All the observations are studied in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Modelling and Controller Design of Sepic Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The SEPIC converter has gained significant attention in renewable energy applications due its unique ability to provide up and down voltage level conversion. For closed loop controlled applications mathematical modelling of converter is essential for describing converter behaviour. In this context, mathematical modelling of SEPIC converter is presented here. At first, the large signal model is developed with state space equations and later steady state model is constructed. The perturbations are introduced in the average large signal model to obtain the small signal model and finally, the transfer functions are obtained by MATLAB programming to describe open loop relations between output and control variable and output and input voltage. The bode diagram and root locus is constructed from the transfer function and SISO tool is used to obtain PI controller gain values. This PI controller is deployed for regulating the output of SEPIC converter. The stability analysis is also discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Interactive Learning System for Art Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article proposes an interactive algorithm to analyze the teaching and learning objectives. Firstly, use instructional design theory to evaluate learners and divide indicators based on teaching and learning requirements to reduce interference factors in teaching. Then, based on the theory of instructional design, a teaching research plan is formed for the teaching and research of art teaching, and the teaching and research results are comprehensively analyzed. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, interactive algorithms have better teaching and research accuracy in art teaching, teaching, and learning time than exploratory teaching mode.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Information Management System for Village and Town Planning and Construction Under the Background of a Rural Revitalization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In response to the current situation where the construction of new rural areas cannot solve the problem of township planning and construction information management systems, the current situation is unreasonable. This article proposes an information management system for rural areas and analyzes its comprehensive information management system. Firstly, use the rural revitalization strategy to evaluate the planning and construction of villages and towns, and divide indicators in accordance with the requirements of information management system to diminish interference factors in the information management system. Then, implement the planning and construction of villages and towns, form a design and implementation plan for the information management system, and conduct a comprehensive analysis of the results of the information management system. MATLAB simulation shows that under the current trend standards, the rationality and rigor of the information management system are better than those of the new rural construction.

Author Keywords: village and town planning and construction

articleTitle: Security Evaluation of Social Networks in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Social interaction is meant to give a certain psychological needs, communication and exchange of views between a number of people. It has to do with being social, and most people want to interact with others. With the increasing development of the Internet, the product of social network has emerged. People can socialize with others anytime and anywhere through the social platform, which is far more efficient and convenient than traditional social communication. However, with the spread of network information, social networking is naturally accompanied by network risks. In order to reduce the impact of network risks on people as much as possible, this paper believes that security assessment should be carried out on social networks and cloud computing should be used as an auxiliary tool. In the last part of this paper, the security of a platform is evaluated according to its security guarantee index, and the final score is about 3.20 points (the score range is 1–5 points). So cloud computing environments can provide a foundation for evaluating the security of social networks and enhance their accuracy.

articleTitle: Seepage Power Aware SBVL Based FinFET Design for SRAM Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The main issue in scaling future technology is changes in process parameters, which are seen as flaws in the development process. Devices are also more vulnerable to ageing, temperature fluctuations, and supply voltage variations in their surroundings. Increased power consumption, a lower maximum working frequency, and more failures are all effects of all these impacts that are seen in integrated circuits. With the development of FinFET technology, the unpredictability brought on by random dopant fluctuations has been largely eliminated. Memory makers' top priorities are still power consumption reduction and SRAM cell stability enhancements. The key characteristics of CMOS and FinFET transistors based on SRAM cells are contrasted in this idea. the comparison of self-biased voltage method (SBVL) and sleep transistor simulations of IOT SRAM cell topologies, which are the two main components of the whole process.

articleTitle: Power Improvement of Partial Shaded Photovoltaic System Using Water Swirl Arrangement Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The phenomenon of the partial shading is major cause which affects the operation of the PV system. The non uniform irradiation mainly caused due to towers, passing of clouds, falling of trees, etc. This becomes the reason to power reduction and mismatch loss. In this developed arrangement method, a new reconfiguration method is developed to enhance the power of the PV system which follows the Water Swirl (WS) pattern. The operation of PV system with minimum mismatch loss of PV array using shaded dispersion method is allowed. For array formation of developed method, the equations with constraints are expressed. Simulation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{9}\times \mathbf{9}$</tex> Photovoltaic arrays is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink and output analysis has been validated. The comparison is made between mismatch loss generation under non-uniform pattern and power improvement with various arrangement methods. The developed arrangement method is good and well than total cross tied and series-parallel patterns methods. For assumed system mismatch losses are minimal and power output is improved using shade dispersion.

articleTitle: Reconstructing Noised Images of Fashion-MNIST Dataset Using Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)

authors.preferredName: Medavarapu T N D Sri Harsha

abstract: In this paper, we delve into the potential of a structured latent space for enhanced data representation, particularly advantageous for tasks such as categorization with sparsely labeled data, effective label selection, and class morphing. Our research encompasses evaluations conducted on diverse benchmark datasets, including ImageNet, MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, DeepFashion2, and a collection of 3D human forms, demonstrating the versatility of our approach. Within the context of Denoising Autoencoder methodologies, our primary aim was to grasp and acquire input representations capable of disregarding inconsequential changes and comprehending the entire image. We introduced noise to the images and employed denoising autoencoders to reconstruct the original images, eliminating noise. Our findings show that a learning rate of 0.1 and 1000 hidden layer nodes were optimal for our model. The model excelled at reconstructing images from the test set when trained with 20% noisy images but struggled to generalize with 70% noise due to overfitting. Training with noisy images yielded improved testing accuracy, and increasing the number of samples for the classification layer was beneficial. However, our model's performance fell short in comparison to Support Vector Machines (SVM).

articleTitle: Analysis of Distributed Photovoltaic Limit Capacity Calculation Taking into Account Multiclassified Least Squares Support Vector Machine Based
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Since the current distributed PV limit capacity calculation process suffers from low accuracy, operational efficiency and unrealistic analysis results, this paper applies multicategorical least squares support vector machine to the calculation process for distributed PV limit capacity. The least squares support vector machine (SVM) is used to obtain the variogram of distributed PV limit capacity to operate local variance on pixels, while the vectors in each direction are analyzed in the distributed PV limit capacity calculation, and then the obtained eigenvalues are combined with least squares support vectors to realize the analysis of distributed PV limit capacity calculation by combining the vectors as distributed PV limit capacity. Finally, the case study results indicate that the IEEE-33 node system can effectively improve the corresponding distributed PV limit capacity during stable system operation based on distribution network. Distributed PV limit capacity can be calculated more accurately by using the proposed algorithm than the traditional method.

Author Keywords: least squares support vector machine Introduction

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Cyber Hacking Breaches in Network Using the Novel CNN GoogleNet Compared Against AlexNet Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The aim of this research study is to predict the Cyber Hacking Breaches at earlier stage using dataset. For this two machine learning algorithms Novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) GoogleNet and AlexNet algorithms were used. Novel CNN GoogleNet and AlexNet are using training and testing dataset splits of cyber hacking breaches. There are 2030 cyber hacking breach images collected for this research study from an open source kaggle web resource. The dataset was split the data was divided into two sets, with 80% of training dataset and a 20% testing dataset. The train data set consists of 1624 images and test data consists of 406 data set images. The g-power test used is about 80% g-power setting parameters: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha = 0.05$</tex> and power=0.85. The experiment study was iterated twenty times using the above said models. This research study has found the Novel CNN GoogleNet algorithm has a 93.40% increased the accuracy, when contrasted with the AlexNet algorithm value 80.76%. The statistical significance level for the T-Test for Independent Samples (p=0.000, p<0.05) with a 95% assurance interval. The CNN GoogleNet has better significant value than AlexNet. The outcome shows has the earlier prediction of Cyber Hacking Breaches. When Comparing the Accuracy of results, it is showing significant improvement on CNN GoogleNet compared over AlexNet in predicting cyber hacking breaches in the early stage.

articleTitle: Modeling and Performance Evaluation of a Grid-Integrated Wind-PV-BESS Hybrid Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: There has recently been a surge in the use of sustainable renewable energy sources. Solar and wind power are the two most popular renewable energy sources. Wind speed and solar irradiance vary inevitable, making grid integration extremely difficult. In the world of increasing demand for electricity meeting up the demand is a challenging task. World looking for upcoming renewable energy technologies for optimized generation with clean and green energy motive to understand working of this generation plants we can do analysis using virtual platforms like, MATLAB, HOMER etc. Above all of the available renewable resources wind and solar is very popular. Hybrid generation by combining this two gaining more interest, this is due to the complementary intermittent nature of these two resources. Using PV array and DFIG wind generation system and a Battery Energy Storage system we built a hybrid Generation model and simulated using MATLAB/Simulink software. Main aim is to analyze Hybrid energy system for its performance by carrying out dynamic and transient stability test. Efforts are made to obtain optimal output from the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regenerative Braking for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The use of kinetic energy lost while braking and downhill vehicle movement is discussed in this paper. The goal of this work is to examine various drive performance and energy loss reduction options. The methods for estimating force, power, and energy are discussed. Characteristics influencing the generative braking vitality are examined. The simulation is used to demonstrate and discuss the benefits of direct control over scalar control of the regeneration strength. Additionally, the capacity of the motor and battery for both acceleration and regenerative braking is determined by a thorough examination of the vehicle's load. Regenerative braking is crucial for maintaining a vehicle's durability and improving energy efficiency. Analysis is done on the factors influencing the regeneration of braking energy. A simulink model must be used for the complete system. which, in order to enhance the design process, comprises the electrical drive, electrical converters, gearbox, and differential. It is addressed how to estimate force, power, and energy. The resultant of this paper is that for different urban drive cycles, the battery performance, like charging and discharging, and how battery voltage and current vary with the drive cycle can be shown.

articleTitle: Human Resource Management of Small and Medium Enterprises Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The main contribution of this article is to design a human resource management system for small and medium-sized enterprises, which introduces salary design and performance evaluation to accurately evaluate the employees of the enterprise. Therefore, on the basis of cloud computing, this article provides convenience for human resource management of small and medium-sized enterprises, realizes innovation in human resource management models, and improves the utilization rate, efficiency, and cost savings of commodity resources. Using statistical analysis methods to study the effectiveness of cloud computing in human resource management of small and medium-sized enterprises. Based on the same evaluation criteria, cloud computing has improved efficiency and satisfaction in talent cultivation, performance management, salary management, human resource consulting services, shared services, and other aspects. Through experimental simulation, it can also be seen that when cloud computing is used, the efficiency of human resources has reached 94%, which is 4 percentage points higher than traditional human resource management.

Author Keywords: Human resource management for small and medium-sized enterprises

articleTitle: A Virtual VR Reconstruction Method for Landscape Architecture Based on Spatiotemporal Algorithm Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and computer science, digital technology has gradually penetrated into various fields, including landscape architecture. With the acceleration of urbanization process, the natural landscape and cultural heritage are facing the threat of destruction and disappearance.Virtual reality technology, as an application of digital technology, allows users to experience virtual environments firsthand by simulating real visual and auditory experiences. The maturity and popularization of digital technology have provided new development opportunities and technological means for the field of landscape architecture. This article studies the virtual VR reconstruction of landscape architecture, aiming to improve the landscape of office areas. In this paper, we mainly use the experimental method and Comparative law method to analyze the spatiotemporal algorithm and virtual reconstruction method. The experimental data shows that the running time of building virtual reconstruction obtained by applying spatiotemporal algorithms is about 6 seconds.

articleTitle: A Self-Attention Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory for Cold Start Movie Recommendation Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Movie recommendation systems are useful tools that help users find relevant results and prevent information overload. On the other hand, the user cold-start issue has arisen because the system lacks sufficient user data. Furthermore, they are not very scalable for use in extensive real-world applications. One of the key strategies to address the sparsity and cold-start problems is to leverage other sources of information, including item or user profiles or user reviews. Processing client feedback is typically a challenging process that involves challenging the interpretation and analysis of the textual data. Thus, this research implements an efficient deep learning-based recommendation architecture. Following the acquisition of textual data from the Amazon product reviews database, stop word removal, lemmatization, and stemming techniques are applied to the data pre-processing which eliminate inconsistent and redundant data, facilitating the process of interpreting and utilising data. Then, the Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) method is applied to extract the feature values from the pre-processed text data. The extracted feature values are fed to the Self-Attention Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (SA-BiLSTM) that utilises the matrix factorization method framework's information sources. The SA-BiLSTM model obtained 95.93% of recall, 94.76% of precision, and 97.84% of accuracy on the amazon product reviews database.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Standard Quaternary Inverters for Noise Margin
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The huge number of interconnections in digital circuits is the main issue in chip design. It is possible to reduce chip size and interconnections by using multi-valued logic, which leads to less power consumption. The use of multi-valued logic has the potential to improve the connection complexity, efficiency of arithmetic circuits, and digital signal processing. Because of the enormous potential of CNTFET in circuit design, several studies into multi-valued logic have been conducted in recent years. The ability of the carbon nanotube field effect transistor to have multi-threshold voltage resulted in its extensive use in designing multi-valued circuits. This study presents a performance analysis of existing standard quaternary inverters based on two definitions of noise to examine their noise sensitivity. The designs are simulated using Synopsys HSPICE with a 32nm model provided by Stanford University. The existing designs are compared in terms of power, delay, PDP, and noise margin.

articleTitle: Machine Vision and Image Processing of Asphalt Pavement Damage Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Asphalt pavement refers to various types of pavement paved with asphalt materials incorporated into mineral materials. Because of the durability of this material, it is one of the most widely used types of road surface. However, even asphalt surfaces can still suffer from breakage and cracks, which can further affect public transportation. Therefore, this paper believes that it is urgent to establish a mature asphalt pavement damage detection system, aiming at timely detection of asphalt pavement damage problems and repair. This paper also argues that the use of machine vision and image processing technology can help the asphalt pavement damage detection system to better extract the pavement crack characteristics and locate the crack coordinates, so as to improve the work efficiency of the system. So this paper introduces these two technologies to improve the basic framework of the system. Finally, this study found that machine vision and image processing can effectively construct a damage detection system for asphalt pavement.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Segmentation in IDRiD using Enhanced U-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Diabetes Retinopathy is the primary reason for avoidable vision loss, especially among people of working age. Diabetes is expected to affect 600 million people worldwide by 2040, with one-third developing Diabetic Retinopathy [1] Recent studies have highlighted the need for more cost-effective and efficient methods of diagnosing, managing, and treating retinal diseases in clinical eye care settings. Before the development of a computer-aided diagnosis tool, the difficulty of achieving an accurate early diagnosis at an affordable cost must be considered. It may be possible to expand diabetic retinopathy screening efforts and allow physicians to use their time more efficiently by utilizing computer-aided disease detection in retinal image processing. Biomedical engineers and computer scientists now have a unique opportunity to meet the demands of clinical practice, thanks to advances in edge computing and machine learning techniques. We have used Enhanced U-Net to segment typical pathological features of DR which include hard exudates (EX), soft exudates (SE), microaneurysms (MA), and haemorrhages (HE) in the Indian Diabetic Retinopathy Image Dataset (IDRiD) with better accuracy than other techniques used in this domain. The Enhanced U-Net is able to segment all the features at an early stage, hence, this method can be used to aid diagnosis of DR at an early stage, thereby preventing vision loss at later stages.

articleTitle: Design and Operation of Bi-Directional CLLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: A new topology known as CLLC has recently gained prominence, in which a capacitor in series is inserted on the secondary side which differs it from LLC converter. The primary side of the transformer has an inverter, while the secondary side has a rectifier, a variable load, and a capacitor is present which acts as filter. Similar to the LLC topology, a llc resonant tank is present which consists of passive components in series such as capacitor, inductor and a parallel magnetising inductor. It is type of DC-DC converter which has the advantage of reduced switching losses and switching noise and it is highly efficient and has an elevated power density but the design of this converter is complicated. In this paper a easier and simplified technique of design of resonant converter is proposed. This document provides a brief description of the operation of CLLC converter as well as detailed design instructions. A design example is provided along with the simulation waveforms. The simulation is carried out in PLECS software.

articleTitle: Dynamic Rule Extraction Method Based on Computer Fuzzy Chinese Language Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the whole dynamic rule extraction method optimization design, how to improve the accuracy of feature extraction and improve the recall rate is the key problem that needs to be solved. This paper studied the importance of dynamic rule extraction, analyzed the application of fuzzy logic in dynamic rule extraction, and explored the methods and steps of data preprocessing and feature selection as well as the generation and update mechanism of dynamic rules. Based on the discussion of the data results, this paper drew the following conclusions: The accuracy of dynamic rule extraction method is about 14.7% higher than the comprehensive average growth rate of traditional methods. Meanwhile, the overall average growth rate of recall rate is around 8 %. This shows that the dynamic rule extraction method based on computer fuzzy Chinese language recognition system has a good effect in practical application. With the growth and diversity of corpora, this method has improved the performance of computer systems in processing Chinese text.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Teaching Reform Model for Computer Public Courses Based on Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article proposes a teaching reform model for computer public courses based on intelligent algorithms, aiming to improve the teaching quality of computer public courses and the learning effectiveness of students. This mode utilizes intelligent algorithms to optimize course content and teaching methods, achieving reasonable allocation of course resources and personalized teaching, and improving students' learning enthusiasm and grades. The experimental results indicate that this model has good feasibility and effectiveness, providing new ideas and methods for the teaching reform of computer public courses. And the learning efficiency of students has doubled compared to traditional methods, reaching 95%.

articleTitle: Application of CEEMDAN Algorithm in MPPT of Grid Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the context of the global energy crisis photovoltaic power(PVP) generation, as a clean energy source, occupies a large proportion of the total energy structure. This paper proposes to use the DBN-XGBoost hybrid algorithm based on PV sequence decomposition and reconstruction to decompose the existing PV system data, to obtain a pattern function sequence with stronger time-domain characteristics, so as to realize the extraction of the time-scale characteristics of the PV system. On this basis, two algorithms, Deep Belief Network (DBN) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), are used to realize the modal composition prediction of the structural model. In terms of orthogonal performance, it can be seen from the data that the orthogonality result of the EMD algorithm is 0.09523, and the orthogonality results of EEMD and CEEMDAN are only 0.01687 and 0.00548. Finally, the simulation results show that compared with other PVP prediction models, the CEEMDAN-DBN-XGBoost PVP prediction model has higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Simulation of Energy-Saving Operation Optimization Model for Urban Rail Transit Based on GRU Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Energy efficiency is a long-term strategic tool for China's socio-economic development and a key issue for railroad construction and operation. The energy used for train operation in urban railroads accounts for about half of the total energy consumption of the entire railroad system. Therefore, reducing the energy consumption of the propulsion system is an effective way to reduce the total energy consumption of urban railroads. This article explored the simulation analysis of an energy-saving operation optimization model for urban rail transit based on the GRU algorithm. This article carefully analyzed the GRU algorithm and introduced the determining factors of energy consumption in urban rail transit, and discussed the application of the GRU algorithm to solve the energy-saving problem of urban rail transit. Finally, by comparing and analyzing the urban rail transit energy saving optimization model based on GRU algorithm with the pre optimization and other algorithms through experiments, the experiment showed that the model based on the algorithm in this paper had better performance (the algorithm in this paper achieved 10% energy saving, and the energy saving of GRU algorithm was 3MJ more than that of Ant colony optimization algorithms).

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Landscape Spatial Environment Based on Interactive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the process of landscape design, the method can effectively establish the output data in the noise and make a comprehensive judgment on the effect of noise on the environment, so it is said that the tax payment algorithm proposed in this round can realize the integration of urban planning and architecture, better carry out spatial planning, and expand the development potential of space.

articleTitle: Enhancing Airline Operations by Flight Delay Prediction - A PySpark Framework Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Airline delay prediction plays a crucial role in the aviation industry, enabling airlines to optimize operations and improve passenger satisfaction. In this research, we propose a comprehensive framework for airline delay prediction using PySpark, a distributed data processing framework. Our study incorporates four widely used machine learning algorithms: Logistic Regression Classifier, Random Forest Classifier, Gradient Boosted Tree Classifier and Decision Tree Classifier. Our experimental results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework. The identified classifiers when implemented achieve promising results in terms of predictive accuracy, highlighting their suitability for airline delay prediction. By comparing and contrasting these algorithms, we provide insights into their respective strengths and limitations. This research presents a robust framework for airline delay prediction, leveraging PySpark's distributed data processing capabilities. The experimental evaluation of multiple machine learning algorithms highlights their efficacy in accurately predicting flight delays. The deployed prediction system showcases the practical application of our framework, paving the way for improved operational efficiency and enhanced passenger experiences in the aviation industry. From the experiments, logistic regression classifier and random forest classifier had better results.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Remote Monitoring Solar Powered Agricultural Motor Pump Using Modbus and MQTT IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Global political and economic initiatives are driving the demand for alternative power sources. Solar power has been the leader amongst other renewable energy sources. In this project the solar power is used to run the agricultural motor pump. The variable frequency drive (VFD) is used as a controller for motor pump and the solar power is given as input to the VFD controller. This VFD controller will controls the motor pump operations. Along with this we are developing a Remote Monitoring System (RMS). The solar power and motor pump values are read by RMS from controller. RMS uses MODBUS communication to read the data from VFD drive, and by using the Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) Protocol all this data is sent to web server. With the help of Global Position System (GPS) tracking we can find the installation location of the motor pump. In this Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) is used for ON/OFF of motor pump through SMS or call. The status of the motor pump whether ON/OFF, its frequency, power, voltage, speed, controller temperature and all its real time values can be seen in web server at any time.

articleTitle: Sensor Fault Diagnosis of Air Conditioning System Based on Multi-dimension Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the development of modern architecture, indoor refrigeration and air conditioning system has become more and more complex. In these complex systems, the ability to accurately and timely detect and diagnose multiple faults is beyond human ability, so fault detection and diagnosis becomes more and more important. The purpose of this paper is to study sensor fault diagnosis of air conditioning system based on multi - dimensional clustering algorithm. This paper describes the basic theory of clustering algorithm and the basic process of sensor fault diagnosis in air conditioning system. Taking the laboratory air conditioning system as the experimental data object, multi-condition modeling data were identified and classified by multi-dimension Gaussian mixture model EM clustering algorithm. By selecting TPR statistics as the test measure, the feasibility and rationality of the strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Exploration on Accounting Data Encryption Processing System Based on DES Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The confidentiality of accounting data is crucial for the security and trade secrets of enterprises. The aim of this study is to explore an accounting data encryption processing system that improves the DES algorithm, enhancing the efficiency and security of data encryption processing. This article optimized the system architecture and algorithm design by introducing safer AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) algorithms, and combined hardware to accelerate the technological process. The experimental results showed that under the same amount of data, the AES algorithm reduced the encryption time by an average of 40% compared to the DES algorithm. This indicated the need to further strengthen key management. It needs to establish a data backup and recovery mechanism, and strengthen security training and awareness enhancement to improve the security performance of the accounting data encryption processing system of DES algorithm. These improvements would provide enterprises with more reliable and effective accounting data protection solutions, ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of accounting data.

articleTitle: 3D Human Posture Capture Algorithm Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: 3D human pose estimation is a research hotspot. The research on this technology can promote the development of other advanced artificial intelligence technologies based on computer vision, such as sports teaching such as music and dance, 3D stereoscopic movies, and human motion pattern recognition, all of which cannot do without the development of this technology. Currently, there are still many researchers in this research field who are researching and developing it. On the basis of current research by researchers, this article explored a convolutional neural network model with semi supervised learning to obtain 3D human body estimation including spatial positions. The proposed method can estimate the corresponding 3D pose skeleton model from the daily motion videos. After experimental testing, the results can confirm that the method proposed in this article is effective and can more accurately estimate the 3D pose of the corresponding video frame (the FPS of the model in this article was 1130 frames/second, which was higher than the model based on the LSTM (Long Short Term Memory) algorithm by 950 frames/second, and the MPJPE value was 43.7mm, indicating that the error between the predicted joint position and the actual joint position based on the algorithm model in this article is minimal).

articleTitle: Design of Music Signal Spectrum Visualization System Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: As an art form and cultural carrier, music is the expression of human's spiritual life and emotional experience, and also plays a subtle influence on people's hearts. The experimental results prove that it can effectively improve the recommendation effect, and the accuracy of the recommendation result is about 1.67% higher than that based on DL, and about 5% higher than that based on association rules, with good scalability and portability. Music spectrum visualization has the characteristics of intuitive image and easy to understand, which can help users deepen their knowledge and understanding of song content, and it is an essential link in the process of music creation. CF's recommendation algorithm can be widely applied to music field. It can not only improve the utilization rate of music resources, but also reduce the human deviation caused by manual screening. This enables accurate and intelligent selection based on personalized recommendations, effectively improving user engagement and satisfaction.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Analysis System of Intelligent Workshop Manufacturing Process Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of the computer technique, the numerical twin technique has been widely used in each field. The digital twin is a kind of image of the material world in the information plane. It is very close to the real world, and it can offer the whole and precise information about the material. In the manufacturing industry, digital twin technology can provide a comprehensive, intuitive, and dynamic visual display platform for the dynamic scheduling analysis of the manufacturing process of the intelligent workshop, and provide support for its realization of intelligent production. This article adopts a digital twin-based intelligent workshop manufacturing process dynamic scheduling analysis system. By constructing the digital twin model and data model of the manufacturing process, the functions of digital twin and simulation, scheduling analysis, and intelligent monitoring of the manufacturing process are realized. The experimental results show that the application of digital twin technology can improve the production quality of the workshop to a maximum of 94.4%.

articleTitle: Construction and Design of a Fengtu Architecture Analysis System Based on Improved GA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the progress of social economy, urban construction has regarded the resources of local customs as one of the indispensable and important factors. Terrestrial resources have enormous development potential and value, therefore reliable data and information support has become particularly important in building planning and design, construction, operation and maintenance, and post management. This article aims to study and analyze the design technology of Fengtu architecture based on improved genetic algorithm (GA), and introduce some brief overview of system construction and implementation. At the same time, by elaborating on the parameter setting methods of traditional universal standard controllers and the optimization principles of related functions, a comprehensive model of soil resource management system will be established. Afterwards, this article tested the performance of the system model, and the test results showed that the memory usage rate of the geotechnical building analysis system was within 2%. It shows that the system has a high efficiency in resource utilization.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dementia Prognostication Using Computational Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Dementia is a progressive neurological condition characterized by a decline in cognitive function. Predicting dementia early offers numerous benefits by allowing for timely interventions and planning. Early diagnosis enables individuals to access treatments and support services, potentially slowing the disease's progression and improving their quality of life. Ultimately, early prediction enhances the overall well-being of individuals affected by this challenging condition. The focus of this investigation centers on the prediction of Dementia by employing a range of Machine Learning algorithms to identify the most suitable one for the task. The dataset employed encompasses 373 individual imaging sessions that were conducted on each patient, spanning a minimum of two visits with a time gap of at least one year between them. We applied algorithms both with and without ensemble techniques, namely the Light Gradient Boost machine, XG Boost Model, Random Forest, and the Support Vector Machine Model (SVM). Notably, the ensemble Gradient Boosting Model demonstrated the most promising performance, achieving an accuracy rate of 91.2%.

articleTitle: Construction of an Improved Intuitionistic Fuzzy Cloud Theory Performance Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Traditional performance evaluation models are difficult to effectively handle a large amount of fuzzy and uncertain information, while intuitionistic fuzzy cloud theory has the advantage of being suitable for solving uncertainty and fuzziness problems. This article analyzed the construction of an improved intuitionistic fuzzy cloud theory performance evaluation model. Based on the principles of intuitionistic fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, indicator weights were constructed, and fuzzy logic and cloud modeling were combined to construct an intuitionistic fuzzy cloud theory performance evaluation model. It was found that the prediction accuracy, accuracy of determining evaluation factor weights, accuracy of overall performance evaluation, and accuracy of decision-making assistance of the improved model were higher than traditional model. The improved intuitionistic fuzzy cloud theory performance evaluation model was more satisfactory to users, with an increase of approximately 12.6% in user satisfaction. This article provided a new perspective for the field of performance evaluation, and was expected to provide new methods.

articleTitle: Application of Decision Tree Intelligent Algorithm in Mathematical Modeling Structure of Automation Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In order to establish a delay automatic control model with lower control error and better reduction of uplink load, based on existing work, this paper adopted decision tree intelligent algorithm to mathematically model the automatic control. Based on this, this article studied the collaborative scheduling mechanism of decision tree intelligent algorithms and the collaborative scheduling of resources. Firstly, this article analyzed the delay uncertainty in the communication process and adopted a probability graph based method to simplify the probability model composed of delay uncertainty, thereby improving the efficiency of delay automatic control. Next, this article explored an online learning method based on decision tree intelligent algorithms to simplify probability models and model them mathematically. Finally, the communication characteristics of the decision tree intelligent algorithm were simulated and control experiments were conducted on the proposed scheme. The experimental results showed that the CART algorithm achieved the best classification results on the four evaluation indicators of F-Measure, G-Mean, AUROC (Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic), and AUPRC (Area Under the Precision Recall Curve) of the diagnostic model for the test dataset established using different modeling methods, with values of 0.92, 0.894, 0.907, and 0.9, respectively.

articleTitle: Real-Time Localization and Mapping Algorithm of Unmanned Vehicle Based on Sensor Data Fusion and SLAM Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: For unmanned vehicles, accurately locating their own position is a very important function. In this paper, an unmanned vehicle is used to make it move freely with irregular trajectories on a map with random distribution of environmental marks, so as to achieve the perception of the surrounding environment and gradually build an environmental map. In order to correct the positioning of unmanned vehicles to obtain more accurate positioning, this paper compares the path, heading, and observed landmarks. The average error in the X direction is 0.530m, and the average error in the Y direction is 0.265m. After using the EKF-SLAM (Extended Kalman Filter-Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) algorithm, the average error in the X direction is 0.32m, and the average error in the Y direction is 0.18m. The research shows that the method proposed in this paper is helpful for autonomous localization and precise navigation of unmanned vehicles.

articleTitle: English Teaching Ability Evaluation Algorithm Based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article first establishes an evaluation index system for English teaching ability, including teaching attitude, teaching methods, teaching level, and other aspects. Then, differential evolution algorithm is used to optimize the weight of indicators, and the teacher's English teaching ability is quantitatively evaluated based on the optimization results. The experimental results show that the English teaching ability evaluation algorithm based on differential evolution algorithm proposed in this article has good evaluation results and high feasibility, and can provide reference for English teaching ability evaluation. At the same time, this algorithm also has good scalability and can be applied to capability evaluation in other fields.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare with Deep Learning Cardiovascular Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Deep learning's introduction to the medical research community is changing the face of Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare. Recent advances in Deep Learning have made it possible to process and analyze massive volumes of medical data, such as photographs, genetic information, and clinical records. There will be far-reaching consequences for healthcare in the future due to this shift. The novelty of this research is developing unique, robust, effective, and economical to provide a transparent answer that will let the patient know, on a statistical level, whether or not a cardiac condition is likely to arise with the help of incorporating the bidirectional LSTM model (BDLSTM)with Catboost. Machine learning techniques can save treatment periods and money for patients and medical providers by eliminating the need for prolonged, costly clinical and laboratory investigations that are often unnecessary. The proposed Catboost model has a 92% success rate in diagnosing cardiac disease, an 88% success rate in diagnosing healthy individuals, and a precision of 93%.

articleTitle: An Efficient QoS Aware Hybrid Localization Model Using Pelican Optimization Algorithm for Cognitive Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The transmission of detected information to a central base station is critical in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). These sensor devices work within the limits of restricted resources due to their compact size and reliance on battery power. To address the constraints of such resource-constrained surroundings, a ground-breaking framework for large-scale applications with an enormous number of sensors distributed across a broad expanse is provided. This novel protocol not only addresses communication challenges, but also ensures the development of a continually flawless communication system. Using cognitive sensors, the integration of learning and thought processes ensures dependable data delivery within the network. Localization is utilized in both sparsely and densely populated sensor networks by applying an intelligent cluster head election and route selection mechanism based on cognitive principles and the Pelican Optimization Algorithm (POA) algorithms. The proposed scheme is examined and compared with the existing methods such as CBSO, EW-DHO and HPSO-CSC. The proposed scheme outperforms Energy consumption by 0.5, Network Lifetime by 6200 and Throughput by 0.99% respectively.

articleTitle: SOA Based Improved Convolutional Neural Network for Detection of DDoS Attack in Banking Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Due to the anticipated rise of the IoT, in which sensors and actuators interact autonomously to provide various forms of smart services, there has been a surge in the demand for embedded devices. The expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) applications now relies heavily on fog computing. However, a DDoS assault on a mining pool in 2017 revealed serious vulnerabilities in the blockchain-enabled IoT. The banking sector is especially vulnerable because of the high pecuniary charge of the data it possesses. As banks increase their digital imprints, so does the attack surface for cybercriminals. This paper's goal is to identify Banking Dataset-based DDOS attacks against banking institutions. In order to upsurge the reliability of the categorization results, this study pre-processes the data. Then, the hybrid model known as an Improved Convolutional Neural Network is fed the extracted features as an input. Using a randomised parametric rectified linear unit (RPReLU) function, this network is constructed. In contrast, the low learning efficiency that results from the standard dropout procedure's zero-setting operation of weights is due to its random nature and its inability to differentiate among features with varying weights. In order to boost the manual orientation and the learning efficiency of the dropout process, this study presents a new dropout approach based on a support vector machine (SVM) and calls it RSCNN. Using the Sandpiper Optimisation algorithm (SOA), the suggested representation's weights are chosen optimally. The experimental consequences demonstrate that the suggested model has a high degree of accuracy (94.66<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), precision (95.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), sensitivity (0.95), and F-score (0.95). The RSCNN-SOA has been found to be more stable than standard methods.

articleTitle: Minimizing the Energy Consumption using Coral Reef Based Energy-Efficient Framework in Internet of Medical Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The internet of things (loT) and In enabling quick action in the event of a medical emergency. It is used to transmit medical records of patients to distant researchers and hospitals for analysis. Low-power biosensor node-based wireless body area networks (WBANs) have been proposed as a means of monitoring patient health; however, addressing the problems of excessive energy consumption and high communication costs is interesting and difficult. The unequal energy consumption among biosensor nodes has a detrimental impact on the healthcare system because it slows down the transfer of patient data to remote centres. The main objective of the research presented in this article is to suggest an IoMT- based Optimised Energy-efficient Framework (OEF) for e- healthcare that reduces biosensor consumption while enabling the transfer of medical data. The results of the simulation indicate that the proposed framework improves the presentation of medical schemes by 18%, 26%, and 29%.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Privacy Preserving for Object Classification Using High-Resolution Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In remote sensing (RS), deep learning (DL) has demonstrated exceptional performance. The field of RS is finding that DL is becoming increasingly useful. The proliferation of cloud platforms that grant access to massive amounts of processing power has made the deployment of DL systems as a service feasible. This, however, has given rise to fresh issues with data privacy and security. Several levels of confidentiality are necessary for the RS data required to teach DL algorithms. High-resolution satellite photos relating to public safety, for example, must be treated with the utmost secrecy. The owner of a satellite picture may also refuse to allow anybody else to use it on the grounds that it is copyright protected. Consequently, privacy-preserving deep learning (PPDL) methods might be the answer. To train DL without exposing the original plaintext, PPDL allows for the use of encrypted data. In order to classify objects in very high-resolution satellite photos, a hybrid PPDL method is proposed in this research. For privacy-preserving to be designed, existing deep learning models and algorithms must be rethought and redesigned from the ground up to meet the stringent technological and algorithmic restrictions of HE. This study presents a primer on the topic of privacy-preserving convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and a technique for their creation. High-resolution photos captured by the SPOT6 and SPOT7 satellites were used in the experiments. Using the suggested encryption approach resulted in a loss of classification accuracy of 2-3.5 percent.

articleTitle: An Identification of Software Defect Using Cost Based Support Vector Machine and Robust Similarity Aware Clustering Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Software fault prediction is the prominent research area that aims at the successful delivery of the software to the clients. The success of the software relies on the successful development of the software without any of the faulty modules. The presence of the large number of the software faults results in ineffective product and the faults may be due to any of the hominoid mistake. The software faults are detected in the stress, computational faults, faults in syntax, capacity, load balance, and so on. It is the need of the hour to detect the faults effectively and precisely, but predicting the software faults remained a challenge. This research proposed a software fault prediction and classification approach based on the combination of the spiral model, Cost based Support Vector Machine (CSVM) and Robust Similarity Aware Clustering (RSC) process. The proposed machine learning algorithm efficiently identify the fault occurred on the software modules. RSC algorithm helps to cluster the resultant classes based on the similarity measure. This proposed technique helps to achieve less computing time and also reduces the failure ratio for testing the software modules. The experimental analysis of the proposed CSVM method is done on publicly available dataset such as NASA-CM1 data. The analysis demonstrated that the proposed algorithm is better than various existing approaches with respect to Accuracy (0.991), Precision (0.944), Recall (0.962), and F-measure (0.945) and such proved that it is capable of predicting faults within limited resource budget.

articleTitle: Segmenting the Liver Tumor from Computed Tomography Using 3D-UNet with IDFOA Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Cancer of the liver is a primary cause of mortality worldwide. Recognising cancerous tumour tissue is a difficult and time-consuming process. When compared to hepatoblastoma and other types of liver cancer, cholangiocarcinoma receives far less attention and statistical analysis. In this study, we analyse images of these two cancers specifically. This research will employ three different designs from the 3D UNet modifications to perform CT-scan segmentation: 3D UNet is the most widely suggested segmentation method for bio-medical pictures. In addition, the classification accuracy is enhanced by the use of hyper-parameter tuning performed by the Improved Dragonfly Optimisation Algorithm (IDFOA). The proposed approach is validated by experimental analysis utilising two datasets, namely 3DIRCADb and the Liver Tumour Segmentation Challenge (LITS). On the first dataset, the suggested model achieved an accuracy of 88%, while on the second dataset, it achieved an accuracy of 92.75.

articleTitle: In-Depth Application of Neural Network in Software Information Classification and Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Neural network is a highly self-learning computing technique capable of handling nonlinear and multivariate data, which has great advantages in improving the efficiency of data processing. By constantly adjusting parameters, neural networks can effectively avoid possible errors in algorithm training. This paper aims to study the application of neural network in information classification. First, the paper introduces the artificial neuron model and its design method. Secondly, this paper deeply discusses the influence of the BP (Back Propagation) layer on the signal feature value extraction process and the reasons for reducing the recognition rate. Afterwards, this paper designs a software information classification and recognition system, and conducts a functional test on the recognition and classification performance of the system. The test results show that the memory usage of the classification information and recognition system is between 1% and 3%, which shows that the system is not bloated and can meet the hardware operation requirements. The application of neural network in software information classification and recognition shows that neural network has potential in solving common problems in the field of artificial intelligence. Neural network is a network composed of artificial neurons that simulate the way of human brain transmitting signals. It learns according to the training data and improves its accuracy over time. Neural network is usually composed of input layer, hidden layer and output layer. Each node (artificial neuron) transmits data through the connection weight and threshold with other nodes.

articleTitle: Network Retrieval of English Teacher Education Resources Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article analyzes the characteristics of online education resources and the concept, classification, and system structure of the English teacher education resource network model, and briefly analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the English teacher education network; And combined with elite strategy, an elite ant colony algorithm was proposed; Based on the WEB logs of the education resource management system, the pheromone update mechanism of the elite ant colony algorithm has been redesigned to play a greater role in the English teacher education resource network.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Edge-Based Intelligent Recognition Method for Substation Pointer Meter Reading
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Nowadays, with the digital transformation of the power grid, the method of manually inspecting and recording the status of equipment in power substations is gradually transitioning to intelligent and automated monitoring. Firstly, an improved YOLOv4 algorithm is utilized to extract the dial region of the meters. Subsequently, an enhanced DeepLabv3+ algorithm is used to segment the dial region. Based on the segmented results, the pointer and edges of the dial are effectively extracted, and the angle between the pointer and the edge is calculated. Finally, the meter reading is determined based on this angle. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can accurately recognize meter readings, with the majority of errors falling within a 1.5% margin. Comparative experiments have also validated the effectiveness of each module in the proposed algorithm. Finally, the algorithm is deployed on the Atlas development board at the edge of the substation for the purpose of meter reading recognition.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection in IoT Platform Using Tuna Swarm Optimization with Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a dynamic and delightful research field in this emerging technology. It can be globally connected with many IoT devices and exchange a large amount of data. However, the threats also developed and misguided the entire network behaviour. This article proposes an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) using the proposed Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) along with the Tuna Swarm Optimization (TSO) to fine tune the hyperparameters and helps to enhance the detection accuracy of attacks that takes place in IoT environment. The data is obtained from NSL-KDD data set and it is pre-processed using Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTE) and it is fed into the stage of feature extraction which is performed using the Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE). After this, the feature selection is performed using optimization-based feature selection approach based on Moth Flame Optimization (MFO) and finally, the detection of attack takes place with the help of TSO-LSTM where the results exhibited by the LSTM are fine-tuned with the help of TSO which helps to enhance the detection accuracy of the model. The detection accuracy of the proposed TSO-LSTM is 99.98% which is comparably higher than the existing approaches such as DBN, SMO-HPSO, CNN-LSTM and BFO-RF with detection accuracy of 99.79%, 99.17%,98.8% and 99.96% respectively.

articleTitle: Multi-Parameter Secure Data Aggregation in Data Centre with Integrity Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Data centers play a crucial role in storing and processing large amounts of data generated by various sources. Secure data aggregation in data centers is essential to protect the integrity and confidentiality of the aggregated data. This paper presented a multi-parameter secure data aggregation scheme (MPDA-S) in a data center environment, incorporating integrity verification techniques. The proposed scheme utilizes encryption and aggregation techniques to ensure confidentiality and accuracy of the aggregated data. Each sensor node generates a secure vector representation of its data, with vector elements storing encrypted values computed using parameter-specific public keys. The vector positions represent the distance between the sensed value and the parameter-specific benchmark. The secure vector elements are then aggregated at the data center to create an aggregated vector, which represents the number of sensors with the same positional difference from the benchmarks. To ensure data integrity, hash values are generated from the sensed data and node IDs, and these hash values are aggregated at both the sensor nodes and the data center. The data center verifies the integrity of the received data by comparing the aggregated hash values. Furthermore, the scheme incorporates authenticity verification techniques to prevent unauthorized modifications to the data. The proposed scheme is evaluated through simulations in a data center environment, considering multiple parameters and varying network sizes. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the scheme in achieving secure data aggregation with integrity verification. The scheme effectively protects against eavesdropping attacks, malicious attacks, and cluster head compromised attacks. It also provides resistance against malleability attacks and replay attacks. The proposed MPDA-S multi-parameter secure data aggregation scheme with integrity verification provides a robust solution for data centers to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of aggregated data. The scheme offers enhanced security measures while maintaining efficient aggregation and communication overhead. It can be applied in real-world data center environments where data integrity and security are of utmost importance.

articleTitle: Implementation of Database Search with Quantum Computing: Grover's Algorithm vs Linear Search
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The present study aims to examine the real-world implications of Grover's algorithm, specifically focusing on its quadratic speedup in contrast to classical linear search techniques employed for unsorted databases. The objective is to bridge the gap between theoretical potential and practical application in the field of quantum computing. This study conducts a comprehensive analysis of Grover's Algorithm and traditional linear search across databases of varying sizes, uniquely contributing by empirically validating Grover's Algorithm's superior performance and aligning it with theoretical expectations. Significantly, the study expands its analysis to encompass larger databases, further affirming the algorithm's utility in handling growing database sizes. This study significantly contributes to the progress of quantum computing through the practical implementation of theoretical principles as well as enhancing the scientific community's understanding of quantum search algorithms and their relative efficacy.

articleTitle: Analysis and Policy Determination of Resource Allocation in National Reserve
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent years, Maasai Mara has paid more and more attention to the protection and utilization of wild animals and other resources. However, there is still a large room for improvement in the utilization of natural resources in Maasai Mara. Therefore, it is necessary to develop alternative specific policies and management strategies to achieve a balance between human interests and natural interests and reduce conflicts between humans and wildlife. This paper aims to build a model to introduce specific policies and management strategies to help better balance the relationship between human and ecology. The results of the model established indicate that population density, tourism GDP, and agricultural GDP are the three factors that have a significant impact on the evaluation of policy effectiveness while increase in the number of elephants and carnivores significantly increases the number of negative human-animal interactions.. Additionally, the establishment of the reserve has a notable effect on biodiversity conservation. Under the guidance of the best policy, in 2027, the GDP of the tourism industry in the Masai Mara National Reserve will reach 7.6606 billion US dollars in the first quarter.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation using Convolutional Neural Networks based Visual Geometry Group 19
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: A Brain Tumour (BT) is an abnormal cell growth that can cause damage to surrounding tissues in the brain. The ability of doctors to treat cancer patients and increase their chances of survival depends on the early detection of brain tumours. Many deep learning techniques are created and recognised for effective brain tumour identification and categorization. This study develops a Deep Learning-based method to deal with the overfitting issue in the classification. In this study, the BraTS - 2015 dataset is used for segmentation and classification. After batch normalisation, the CNN convolutional layer receives the pre-processed data and uses it to extract features from Magnetic Resonance Images (MRIs). After that, the Simulated Annealing (SA) technique is used to effectively pick features. In order to achieve effective classification, this research presents a segmentation method based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and a Visual Geometry Group 19 (VGG-19) technique. The performance of the developed CNN-VGG-19 is assessed using several tumour locations, including Whole Tumour (WT), Tumour Core (TC), and Enhancing Tumour (ET). The developed strategy delivers improved results in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy when compared to the current techniques.
