articleTitle: A Secure IoT Based Wireless Sensor Network for an Efficient Modified User Authentication and Key Agreement Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Medical and transportation systems are only two examples of the many domains in which the IoT has found success. To meet the growing demand for continuous health surveillance that is affordable, noninvasive, and long-term, smart healthcare platforms have emerged as the most efficient and useful alternatives. To improve the reliability of IoT devices in smart cities, this study first establishes a cloud-assisted dependability evaluation approach, as reliability examination for IoT gadgets is a crucial part of data source authentication. In addition, a non-interactive zero-knowledge argument-based anonymous verification and key agreement system is developed to address the issue of user privacy being compromised during the process of verification. The proposed method may safeguard sensitive information collected by Internet of Things gadgets in smart cities. The experimental modeling shows that the proposed method outperforms competing approaches by a significant margin. Lastly, the suggested strategy is demonstrated to be more practical and secure than the previous schemes by comparison of effectiveness.

articleTitle: Image Recognition of Maize Pests and Diseases Based on Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Crop disease recognition techniques based on convolutional neural networks, although accurate, are difficult to be extended in complex environments due to the limitations of sample collection and research objects. In this paper, an improved convolutional neural network approach is proposed as an example of maize disease identification, focusing on the identification and classification of pests and diseases affecting maize crops through image analysis using improved convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The factors affecting the application effect of the dataset were investigated by processing the dataset with magnification, scaling, background removal and local fine segmentation, and the optimised recognition model was used to design a disease recognition system based on mobile terminals and validated in the field. By comparing the recognition of four diseases and pests, including round spot, grey leaf spot and rust of soil maize, the results show that the recognition accuracy of the model can reach 0.9742 and the misclassification rate is 0.0258, which is improved compared with other models.

articleTitle: Method for Remote-Control of Electrical Automation Instruments Over Wireless Networks Based on PLC Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This research introduces an innovative approach for the remote-control of electrical automation instruments, utilizing PLC technology within a virtual wireless network. Acknowledging the fundamental role of remote-control in boosting efficiency, safety, and reliability of automation systems, this study explores the capabilities of PLC in meeting these objectives. A comprehensive examination of PLC principles, its optimized deployment, and potential obstacles in intricate industrial settings is undertaken. PLC-based remote-control systems enhance real-time control and monitoring capabilities substantially, evidenced by a reduction in system response times by 25% and an increase in operational efficiency by 30%, providing a cost-efficient and effective solution across various automation scenarios. Furthermore, the study finds that these systems reduce maintenance costs by 20%, demonstrating notable economic benefits. This paper contributes to the expanding knowledge base in the field of automation control, potentially paving the way for the development of more advanced and efficient automation systems. The wider implications of this study can influence diverse sectors, from manufacturing to energy management, leading to improved operational efficiency and productivity.

articleTitle: Classification of Lung Cancer Using Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network Based Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Cancer is a deadly disease caused by a grouping of genetic diseases and several varieties of biochemical abnormalities. Colon and lung cancer appeared as two of the leading causes of death and human disability. The histological diagnosis of such tumors is typically the most critical factor in selecting the optimal course of therapy. The primary aim of this study is to identify malignant lung nodules in a given lung image and to categorize lung cancer and its seriousness. To identify lung nodules, Deep Learning (DL) models are used to categorize the lung cancer stages. A lung nodule is detected using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which identifies a nodule that is precisely segmented and categorized. The proposed approach is divided into two sections: the first is used to categorize normal and aberrant behavior, and the second is used to categorize the various lung cancer stages. In the classification stage, characteristics based on texture and intensity are extracted. The right edge image and morphological thinning operation are applied to improve segmentation performance. The hybrid CNN based Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-Bi-LSTM) model achieves better classification results using performance metrics like accuracy, specificity, sensitivity, and f1-score values of about 99.41%, 99.39%, 99.43% and 99.18% respectively comparing with existing methods.

articleTitle: Multimodal Biometric Authentication System using Probabilistic Fuzzy based Tuna Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The biometric system plays a maj or role in data security with better growth rate. The multimodal biometric system with better accuracy and the rate of recognition still acts as the challenging issue. So, this research introduced probabilistic fuzzy based Tuna Search Optimization (TSO) to recognize the biometrics with score level fusion. Initially, the data is acquisitioned and the pre-processing is performed on both the samples of fingerprint and iris. The features from the processed output is extracted and provided as input for the stage of score level fusion. The efficiency of the proposed approach is evaluated by means of False Acceptance Rate (FAR), False Rejection Rate (FRR), accuracy and equal error rate. The experimental results show that the proposed approach achieved better results in overall metrics when it is compared with the existing techniques. The accuracy of the proposed approach is 99.96% which is comparably higher than the existing approaches such as adaptive fuzzy genetic algorithm, modified relief feature selection and multi-support vector machine and optimized fuzzy genetic algorithm with accuracies of 96%, 97% and 99.83 % respectively.

articleTitle: White Shark Optimizer Based Modified CNN Model for Segmentation and Classification of Tomato Plant Leaves
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Due to the bio-hazards posed by climate change impacts, extreme weather has received greater attention during the past decade. As a result, rising a system for the automatic identification of disease in tomato plant leaves is crucial. The classification of plant diseases is only one area where deep learning (DL) has recently shown amazing results, thanks in large part to the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). In this study, we introduce M-Net, a fully automated extracted from the input data the afflicted region, which is susceptible to harm at the early stage of tomato. In addition, the White Shark Optimization Algorithm (WSOA) is used to pick the best value for the M-Net's weight. An overall accuracy of 95% was achieved, proving that the suggested deep learning strategy is an improvement over previously used deep semantic segmentation methods and has the potential to significantly lessen the effect on farmers.

articleTitle: Music Emotion Recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks for Regional Languages
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Music emotion recognition is a challenging task that has been getting increasing kindness in the field of artificial intelligence. We propose a unique lD Convolutional Neural Network (lD CNN) method for music emotion recognition. Our proposed approach combines the advantages of convolutional neural networks with the lD temporal structure of music signals. Evaluate our model on two publicly available datasets and demonstrate its effectiveness in accurately recognizing different emotions from music signals. Our method presents a novel approach to abstracting raw audio signals into meaningful representations. It utilizes multiple lD convolutional and pooling layers to extract features from the raw audio signals, which can then be used for further analysis. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach by providing examples of applications that can benefit from this abstraction process, such as sound recognition and speech recognition. Additionally, we discuss the potential of this method to be applied in other areas such as natural language processing and music generation. We compare the performance of our model with traditional machine learning (ML) methods and demonstrate that our lD CNN outperforms these traditional ML methods in terms of accuracy. We also discuss potential use cases for this technology and its implications for future research in audio signal processing. We show that our model achieves superior results in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency, making it a promising solution for music emotion recognition tasks. Our results suggest that the lD CNN approach is an effective tool for recognizing musical emotions with high accuracy

articleTitle: Innovative Exploration of Smart University Archives Management Based on Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article proposes a design method for an intelligent management system for university archives based on learning algorithms. This system utilizes advanced learning algorithms and artificial intelligence technology to intelligently manage and classify university archive data, improving the efficiency and accuracy of archive management. This article provides a detailed introduction to the design and implementation process of the system, including functional modules, data flow, and key technologies. Through experimental verification, this system can effectively improve the performance and efficiency of university archives management, providing strong support for the construction of smart campuses in universities. And through experimental simulation, it can also be seen that the management system based on learning algorithms proposed in this article has much higher operational efficiency than ordinary management systems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Community Product Service System Based on Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article proposes a design and implementation scheme for an intelligent community product service system based on classification algorithms. The system aims to solve the problem of product service recommendation and management in intelligent communities, in order to improve the quality of life and satisfaction of community residents. By analyzing the shortcomings of existing community product service systems, this article proposes a method of using classification algorithms for product service recommendation to achieve more accurate and personalized services. The experimental results indicate that the system can effectively improve the recommendation accuracy and user satisfaction of product services, providing new ideas and methods for the construction and development of intelligent communities.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare System Evaluation Using Fuzzy AHP and Fuzzy TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Healthcare systems face growing complexity and diversity, It involves effective evaluation methodologies. This paper utilizes Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Fuzzy Technique for Order of Performance by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) to rank the healthcare system types assiduously. In this paper, we have focused on four key criteria that were chosen for their significance in shaping the quality of healthcare and its accessibility. These criteria were selected to assess the impact on the healthcare system's overall effectiveness, quality, and patient accessibility. Fuzzy AHP is used to provide the framework for prioritizing the criteria and Fuzzy TOPSIS is used to rank the overall performance of different types of healthcare systems. The purpose of this paper is to prioritize the criteria and provide effective that can help in future healthcare research. Ultimately, our aim is to improve patient well-being and the overall efficiency of healthcare delivery. From this research work it is observed that among all the 4 alternatives, single-payer system has got the more priority than the other alternatives with the closeness coefficient of 0.548.

articleTitle: Development of RL -Based Adaptive Congestion Control Algorithm for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Existing queue-centric algorithms for the congestion management faces problems of reliability, flexibility, and adaptability. Recently, several algorithms focuses on managing queue length and windows for congestion control. Congestion is a major bottleneck in wireless networks. This paper introduces an algorithm for congestion control in wireless networks, leveraging machine-learning techniques. The machine-learning algorithm presented here is an expansion of reinforced learning (RL). The RL algorithm segments the traffic scenario into three conditions: underload, overload, and ideal load. The proposed algorithm predicts future traffic behaviors and controls congestion in wireless communication. Ad-hoc On-Demand Distance Vector (AODV) is the primary routing algorithm, and queue management is a protocol modification. The results of the proposed algorithm were highly efficient, showing significant improvements in terms of packet delivery, throughput, and network loss. The empirical difference in results with the RED and CLM algorithms, such as packet drop ratio increasing by 18% and delay decreasing by 28%.

articleTitle: Research on Economical Operation of Distributed Power Based on SVM and PSO Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: At present, how to improve the operating economy of distributed power generation is still a core issue. To solve this problem, a distributed power generation operating economy optimization method based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithms is proposed. The results showed that when the accuracy of all algorithms was 0.900, the recall rates of the obtained research method, MOA-RF, and EWT were 0.827, 0.641, and 0.583, respectively. When the time was 14:00:00, the a average absolute percentage errors of the research method, ABC-SVM, and PSO-RF were 0.97%, 4.47%, and 6.33%, respectively. The cost savings of distributed power generation operation obtained through the use of research methods are significant, and the economic benefits are most significantly improved. The above results indicate that the research method has high operational efficiency and can effectively optimize the economy of distributed power generation operation, with high application value.

articleTitle: A Cluster Based Routing Using Energy Efficiency-Based Multi-Objective Optimization in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a growing technology used for monitoring the physical world. The WSN's sensors are utilised to monitor the surrounding environment, and the information gathered is communicated wirelessly. The primary objective of wireless sensor network design is to maximise network lifetime. Network lifetime can be extended and energy consumption can be properly balanced through the use of clustering and routing. However, the WSN's restricted battery supply means that energy efficiency is regarded as a difficult task in a network. In this paper, an Energy Efficiency-based Multi-Objective Optimization method (EE- MOOA) is used to construct a cluster-based routing method for achieving energy efficiency in WSN. The Improved Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (IBOA) is used in the development of the EE-MOOA. Improving energy efficiency is the main goal of the EE-MOOA approach, which aims to improve data delivery for WSNs agricultural applications. The energy efficiency of the EE-MOOA method is 99.12% for 100 nodes, which is a higher measure when compared to the energy efficiency value of existing methods.

articleTitle: Fog Computing based Privacy Preservation via Distributed Access Control System in Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The proliferation of loT -enabled gadgets means that ever more information is being created and transmitted over the web. The release of sensitive loT data, however, is a privacy breach. Sensitive information generated by loT devices poses a serious security risk since it is transmitted across an unsecured network. The storage issue may be managed with the help of an external cloud. Cloud storage has the potential to compromise users' privacy. To prevent unauthorised access and maintain confidentiality during data transmission, current systems include symmetric encryption and access restrictions. Blockchain is an exciting distributed ledger technology with the potential to safeguard stored information against manipulation by unscrupulous actors. To protect information from Internet of Things devices, this article suggests using a blockchain-based decentralised access control system. Fog computing and the idea of an alliance chain provide the basis for the suggested approach. In order to encrypt and divide data at the network's edge, fog nodes are employed. Homomorphic encryption is used on the third-party cloud to combine data that has been partitioned and encrypted. The suggested system provides dynamic and granular access control for loT data, mitigating the risk of a single point of failure in access control. Results from experiments showed that this approach effectively protects the confidentiality of data collected from Internet of Things devices.

articleTitle: Defending Crop Recommendation Systems Against Poisoning and Evasion Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Crop recommendation systems play a critical role in modern agriculture, providing personalized guidance for optimal crop selection and cultivation practices. However, these systems are vulnerable to adversarial attacks that can compromise their performance, integrity, and privacy. This research focuses on defending crop recommendation systems against poisoning and evasion attacks, which aim to manipulate the training data and deceive the model during prediction, respectively. The research investigates the vulnerabilities of crop recommendation systems to adversarial attacks and analyzes potential risks and consequences. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed defenses, extensive experiments are conducted using a real-world dataset of crop information. The results demonstrate the susceptibility of crop recommendation systems to adversarial attacks. Specifically, the accuracy of the model decreases to 0.64 and 0.65 under poisoned attacks, while the precision drops to 0.77 and 0.65. However, after implementing the defense mechanisms, the model's accuracy and precision improve to 0.73 and 0.75, respectively. Additionally, under evasion attacks, the model's recall decreases to 0.48 and the F1-score drops to 0.70. Nevertheless, the defense mechanisms significantly improve the model's recall to 0.86 and the F1-score to 0.80. The research also assesses the performance of the defense mechanisms by quantifying their ability to detect and mitigate adversarial attacks, demonstrating significant improvements achieved through their deployment.

articleTitle: Semantic Feature Extraction-Based Twitter Sentiment Analysis Using Atom Search Optimizer and Ensemble Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In modern days, a computer-based technique called natural language processing (NLP) is used to process spoken and written natural language data that is specific to human culture. Numerous NLP research directions and technologies have steadily arisen in the process of mining large amounts of textual data. Furthermore, prior models ignored the combined effect of relative distance and grammatical distance on the aspect words, instead only including the relative or grammatical distance of words into the model. This study examines the use of learning algorithms for Twitter sentiment analysis that is based on emotions like fear, anger, joy, and sadness. Sentiment-140 dataset is used in this research to conduct the analysis. First, a pre-processing step using tokenization, stemming, adding part of speech, and punctuation removal is carried out using the collected datasets. Then, using Bag of Words (BoW), Latent Dirichlet Analysis (LDA), Term Frequency, and Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF), the processed data is employed for semantic feature extraction. The next step is to choose the best features for accurate classification using the Atom Search Optimizer (ASO). Finally, the chosen features are divided into various classes using a Voting based Ensemble Classifier (VEC). From the experimental results, it is observed that the proposed VEC has outperformed existing methods by obtaining 98.69% of accuracy on and Sentiment-140 dataset.

articleTitle: End-to-End Hyperspectral Image Classification Using Hybrid GCNN with SWIN Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification holds immense significance in remote sensing applications like land cover mapping and environmental monitoring. This study introduces Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (GCNN) with the SWIN Transformer model (G_SwTr) to enhance HSI classification accuracy. GCNNs are utilized to incorporate spatial information through graph representations, capturing spectral-spatial dependencies. Graph convolutions, effectively harnesses spectral and spatial attributes, further the integration of the SWIN Transformer, recognized for its proficiency in capturing long-range dependencies via shifted windows and hierarchical processing, elevates feature extraction and contextual understanding. The Proposed G_SwTr model is evaluated across three HSI datasets (Pavia-University, Indian-Pines, and Salinas) and is compared against traditional Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods. The results achieved outperform state-of-art methods, with an outstanding Overall Accuracy (O.A) of 99.7, 99.9, and 99.5, an average accuracy (A.A) of 99.5, 99.6, and 98.2, and a kappa coefficient (K) of 99.5, 99.6, and 98.3 for all three datasets.

articleTitle: Fleet Load Charge Forecasting in Electric Vehicle Using Hybrid Deep Learning Model: LSTM-AQOA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: When a high number of electric vehicles in a concentrated area are all charging at once from the same local transformer, the grid's performance, efficiency, and necessary capacity are all impacted. Thus, for a power system to function dependably and efficiently, precise load forecasting is essential. Charging loads from EV fleets are predicted to rise in importance to power grids. Therefore, anticipating the load from EV fleets is critical to ensuring the continued security and dependability of the electrical grid. In this study, we provide a novel hybrid EV fleet charging forecasting model based on multiple decomposition. Long short-term memory (LSTM) is one component of the artificial intelligence (AI) based forecasting model into which each deconstructed signal is input. Aquila Optimisation Algorithm (AQOA) is used to pick the best possible LSTM error threshold value in this case. The accuracy of the models is checked against actual charging data for EV fleets in the wild. Through a comparison of the deployed models, the prediction presentation of the projected model is measured using a variety of statistical measures. It is shown that, compared to models with only one decomposition, models with multiple decompositions perform better across a wide range of measures.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Enabled Real-Time Energy Dispatch of Energy Systems with Flexible Operational Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This paper developed a reinforcement learning- enabled real-time energy dispatch solution for energy systems with flexible operational resources. The detailed process of the proposed solution is formulated and implemented. The deep reinforcement learning method is introduced to solve the action strategy of the energy storage system and the controllable generator. Specifially, this work developed a reinforcement learning-enabled real-time energy dispatch solution for energy systems considering the presence of flexible operational resources. For the real-time scheduling phase, the timing decision problem of real-time scheduling is designed to maintain the stability of the trading curve. The deep reinforcement learning algorithm is designed and adopted to identify the action strategy of the energy storage system and the controllable generator. The proposed solution is evaluated through a case study via simulations and the numerical results confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed real-time energy dispatch solution for multi-energy systems.

articleTitle: Diagnostic Framework for Mumps Based on Deep Learning with Enhanced Mayfly Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The mumps virus causes a very infectious sickness. The enlargement of the parotid salivary glands can be quite uncomfortable. Mumps treatment centers on symptom management. The illness must take its natural course. While most people experience very moderate symptoms, some develop severe consequences. The mumps virus can be avoided with the use of the MMR vaccination. In this research, we employ a convolutional neural network (CNN) technique to better automate mumps detection. In order to automate mumps detection, the authors of this research suggest a convolutional neural network (CNN) trained using XGBoost Classifier data. Incorporating machine learning (ML) technique comparisons. A mumps dataset consisting of 50×50 RGB picture patches served as the basis for all the models. Quantitative findings from each approach were put through validation testing based on their respective effectiveness metrics. To improve the efficiency of the model, the Mayfly Optimization Algorithm is implemented. Results show that the suggested method is effective, with 97% accuracy, suggesting that it might help decrease diagnostic errors caused by human error. And the suggested system we've developed is so precise that it outperforms the CNN model, which only gets around 92% of the time. Consequently, the suggested method is 5% more accurate than the CNN Model.

articleTitle: Design of Machine Automatic Translation System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of China's economy and technology, the scope of English use is expanding, and the system of English Chinese translation is also emerging, and the scope of English use is also expanding. However, currently, there are common problems in English Chinese translation systems, such as low translation efficiency, grammatical errors, and semantic inconsistencies, which bring great inconvenience to English translation and cannot meet people's needs for interactive translation well. This article investigates the creation of an AI-based machine translation system based on the aforementioned problems. This article first provides an overview of AI (artificial intelligence) and machine automatic translation systems, and then discusses how to build a machine automatic translation system. Finally, through experimental comparison and analysis of the system performance of this article, reference [2], and reference [3], the experimental results show that when the semantic sample set size is 10Bit, the accuracy of the translation system is 65%, and it increases with the sample set size, but always higher than other systems. Comparing the recall rate and matching rate, the performance of the translation system in this article is also superior to other systems.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Urban and Rural Planning Analysis Model Based on K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent years, traditional urban and rural planning analysis models have been continuously improved to deal with complex problems. Since the traditional model still has defects, the design and application of urban and rural planning analysis model based on K-Means algorithm are proposed. The K-Means algorithm is used to analyze urban and rural planning, and the basic workflow of the model is obtained, and the model is established and verified by application. The application in Keshan Town, Keshan County, Heilongjiang Province shows that the analysis results of the K-Means model are consistent with the actual situation and are better than other models.

articleTitle: Scheduling Optimization Design of IoT Embedded System Based on Improved RMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the significance of embedded systems has grown exponentially across various fields. This research focuses on addressing the critical issue of task scheduling optimization in IoT embedded systems by introducing an innovative solution based on the Improved Rate Monotonic Scheduling (RMS) algorithm. This improved algorithm plays a pivotal role in enhancing task efficiency and resource utilization in dynamic IoT environments, where the system's workload and priorities are constantly changing. Through extensive testing and evaluation, our proposed solution has demonstrated its superiority over the traditional RMS algorithm. Specifically, the results reveal a remarkable 25% reduction in task response time, showcasing the substantial improvement in system responsiveness. Additionally, there is a notable 30% increase in CPU utilization, which highlights the enhanced utilization of available computing resources. These outcomes collectively underscore the increased reliability and stability of IoT embedded systems achieved through our research.

articleTitle: A Linear Nearest Neighbour Lasso Step Based Honey Badger Algorithm for Robust Network Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Nowadays, one of the biggest issues facing network-based intrusion detection systems are handling massive volumes of network data (IDS). These data typically have a large number of duplicated or unnecessary attributes. Using feature selection techniques, pertinent features must be extracted from the original data in order to increase the effectiveness of IDS. Feature selection is a crucial component of intrusion detection and helps to enhance intrusion detection performance. For feature selection of network intrusion detection, a Honey Badger method based on Linear Nearest Neighbour Lasso Step (LNNLS-HB) is presented to address the issue of low efficiency and high false positive rate in IDS caused by increasing high-dimensional data. The LNNLS-HB algorithm's fitness evaluation function incorporates the quantity of characteristics used and the precision of the classification. Finally, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classification is performed optimal solution, the updated HB location is subjected to the linear closest neighbour lasso step optimisation. To assess and compare the performance of the proposed methodology with other widely used feature selection techniques, the intrusion detection benchmark dataset (CIC-IDS2017) is used. Empirical results demonstrate that the proposed LNNLS-HB achieves a better accuracy of 99.52% when compared with the existing methods.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Modified Reward Function for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Nowadays, crop yield prediction is one of the major fields in a research area, the details about the preferable crops will be useful for the farmers to raise the crops. Models based on deep learning are often utilised to extract important crop features for prediction. Despite the possibility that these approaches could address the yield prediction problem, they have the following shortcomings: unable to produce a linear mapping between crop yield values and raw data; also, the effectiveness of those models is largely dependent on the calibre of the features that were extracted. For the aforementioned drawbacks, deep reinforcement learning offers guidance and inspiration. In order to predict agricultural productivity in time series data, the suggested work builds a Deep Reinforcement Learning with the Modified Reward Function (DRL-MRF). To help the crop productivity prediction, the reinforcement learning agent combines a set of parametric features with the threshold. This model can gather more rewards to carry out the search process and maybe produce useful follow-up proposals and classification scores by using the updated reward function. The evaluated result represents that the proposed DRL-MRF method delivers evaluation metrics such as R2, MAE, MSE, and RMSE values of about 0.99, 0.81, 0.72 and 0.79 respectively which ensures the accurate yield prediction compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Data Security Mechanism of Digital Library Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Blockchain technology has unique advantages in the construction of smart libraries, but its centralized storage method and unlimited replication of dual data bring unreliable data, reader privacy, and intellectual property issues to smart libraries. This article proposes a deep integration of digital twin and blockchain technology, utilizing the decentralized and tamper resistant characteristics of blockchain to store digital twin data in intelligent libraries. The experimental testing of this study shows that the evaluation accuracy of the blockchain library data security evaluation model based on the SAE Kmeans++algorithm reaches 99.8%, which is significantly improved compared to traditional methods. This means that the security system design based on blockchain not only meets the national requirements for the internal network information security protection capability of libraries, but also meets the relevant market requirements for IDC security.

articleTitle: E-commerce Product Review Analysis based on Multi-class Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Recently, an extensive number of consumers can choose their best options from automated retailers and compare products in online stores. Sentiment analysis is frequently employed in applications meant to demonstrate and provide client service as the voice of the user. On E-commerce websites, user reviews provide helpful information about the product. Sentiment analysis of the text reviews helps forecast product sales by assessing user sentiment regarding the product. The Word Embedding Attention approach assigns additional weight to words that have a strong association with a specific class. Sentiment analysis machine learning models provide a thorough depiction of capabilities and far surpass conventional feature-based methods. The obj ective of this research is to improve sentiment analysis performance by creating a weighted ensemble with a Multi-class Support Vector Machine (MSVM) model utilising novel word embedding techniques. Because of the weighted ensemble's higher generalisation skills, MSVM produces superior results. When comparing existing methods for sentiment analysis, the Weighted ensemble with MSVM has produced higher results in terms of accuracy, precision, f-score, and recall. The Weighted ensemble with an MSVM has achieved 99.87 % accuracy, 99.39% precision, 99.03% f-score, and 99.690/0 recall in sentiment analysis when comparing existing methods such as LSTM+FL, APSO-LSTM, ABCDM, SSentiA, and Hybrid CNN+LSTM.

articleTitle: Multifactor Based Ensemble Assertion Framework for Privacy Preservation of Various Business Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In large enterprises in India having many privacy and integrity issues to solve in the vast number of data communication over Business to Business(B2B) and Business to Consumer (B2C) models. At the same time the system has many notable and predicted privacy threats over different types of networks. This study has a focus on privacy preservation while transferring the data between and within enterprises. The balance between data utility and privacy loss could not be matched on a Bigdata set by the standard models K-anonymity and Differential Privacy. A new framework a Multifactor based Ensemble Assertion Framework (MEAF) for Privacy preservation on large-scale data handled by B2B and B2C data transmission models will be proposed. This “MEAF” framework using Private Aggregation of Teacher Ensembles (PATE) machine learning algorithm will preserve the privacy on various business environment with higher accuracy of 89.82%. Also, this framework will go through various considerations when privacy-preserving systems employ Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques and set the Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) that are suitable for all client types and typical commercial uses. The research paper also addresses the observations of the suggested framework and associated problems.

articleTitle: Prediction of Startup Performance Using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory with Parametric Switch Activation Function
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Predicting start-up success has garnered increasing attention in recent years. Numerous predictive models and methodologies have been devised to ascertain the probability of a start-up's triumph contingent on diverse aspects. Large datasets have been analysed using machine learning techniques like logistic regression, decision trees, and neural networks to find patterns that can help predict startup success. Predicting the success of a start-up, however, is a difficult undertaking because the business environment is unpredictable and changeable. Efficient resource utilization is crucial for economic development and has a direct impact on reducing unemployment rates. In order to minimize resource wastage and mitigate the risk of failure, the research identified and examined specific factors that influence the success or failure of small-scale companies. In the current research, the Crunch Base dataset is utilized to predict the failure or success of start-ups by employing the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) with Parametric Switch Activation (PSA) function model. The Bi-LSTM unit, a type of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), incorporates the Feed Forward Neural (FFN) Network for classification purposes. The suggested Bi-LSTM model achieved a higher accuracy rate of 72.26% compared to existing methods. The suggested Bi-LSTM model achieved a higher accuracy rate of 72.26% compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Apriori Algorithm Based Exam Information Service Web App Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This academic paper presents the design and implementation of an Apriori Algorithm-Based Exam Information Service Web App. The web app aims to provide personalized recommendations and valuable insights to users to enhance their exam preparation process. The system architecture, data preprocessing techniques, Apriori algorithm implementation, and evaluation of system performance and user satisfaction are discussed in detail.The system architecture of the web app is designed to efficiently retrieve exam-related information and generate personalized recommendations based on user preferences. The components and functionality of the system are outlined, emphasizing the importance of data preprocessing, association rule mining, and recommendation generation.The results of the evaluation indicate that the Apriori Algorithm-Based Exam Information Service Web App shows promising performance. The recommendation system achieves high precision and recall, indicating the relevance and retrieval of relevant recommendations. The coverage metric demonstrates the system's ability to recommend items from a diverse set. User satisfaction ratings further validate the effectiveness of the system in meeting user needs and expectations.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Intrusion Detection in Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The intrusion detection systems (IDS) play a vital role in both identifying malicious activity and enhancing network security. An IDS must be introduced to mitigate and identify hostile attacks within networks. In recent years, IDS has become a critical issue in the cyber security of Machine Learning, and Deep Learning techniques have been applied to IDS to increase their efficiency and accuracy. In this paper, several methods such as Stacked Contractive Autoencoder with Support Vector Machine, Convolutional Neural Network with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory, Particle Swarm Optimization with Convolutional Neural Network, and Convolutional Neural Network are used in the feature extraction process. Second, the Trust-based Intrusion Detection and Classification System, Modified version of Growth Optimizer, Aquila Optimizer, and Transient Search Optimizer methods are used in this process for feature selection. Finally, K-means with Random Forest, Single Hidden Layer Feed-Forward Neural Network, and Decision Tress methods are utilized in the classification. Extensive evaluation and comparisons of the proposed approaches were conducted by utilizing public datasets from cloud and IoT settings. The methods employed yielded outstanding outcomes in terms of identifying previously undiscovered attacks with a high degree of precision.

articleTitle: Design of Financial Management Teaching System Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article studies the design and implementation of a financial management teaching system based on genetic algorithms. By introducing genetic algorithm as an optimization tool, the system can provide more scientific, effective, and personalized solutions for financial management teaching, helping students better understand and master the knowledge and skills of financial management. This article provides a detailed description of the design and implementation process of the system, including requirement analysis, system design, algorithm implementation, and experimental verification. The experimental results indicate that the system can improve teaching effectiveness and learning experience, providing new ideas and methods for financial management teaching.

articleTitle: Intelligent Early Warning Method for Distribution Network Operation Risk Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The reliable operation of distribution networks is crucial for ensuring the uninterrupted supply of electricity to consumers. However, these networks face various risks that can lead to disruptions and pose significant challenges for network operators. To address this issue, an intelligent early warning method for distribution network operation risk based on an improved particle swarm algorithm is proposed in this study. The findings indicate that the proposed intelligent early warning method outperforms existing approaches in terms of accuracy, computational efficiency, and early warning timeliness. The method's ability to accurately identify risks and provide real-time warnings empowers network operators to take proactive measures, ensuring the stability, reliability, and resilience of distribution networks. The research contributes to the advancement of intelligent decision support systems for power system operation and opens avenues for further research in risk management and optimization techniques.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Active Distribution Network Energy Storage Security Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Exploring the optimal allocation method of energy storage in the overall operation of active distribution network, improving the performance of configuration model and Algorithmic efficiency. This paper first analyzes the safety characteristics of active distribution network including energy storage, and constructs the safety observation index and safety domain model. On this basis, improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to study the optimal allocation method of energy storage safety of active distribution network, and simulation experiments are conducted to verify the optimization effect of the algorithm and allocation method. The results show that this article has made improvements to the initialization stage and speed update stage of the MOPSO algorithm, which can greatly improve the stability of the algorithm and increase computational time. The two-step energy storage optimization configuration method proposed in this article has significantly improved the overall security of the system, and prioritized the allocation of energy storage in areas with weak security in the system, making the system security more balanced.

articleTitle: Empowering Investors: Insights from Sentiment Analysis, FFT, and Regression in Indian Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis has become a tool, for analyzing text data and extracting insights. In our research, we use sentiment examination techniques to calculate stock market trends in the market. We collected a dataset of news articles from two years focusing on financial news related to Indian stocks obtained through the Google News API. Using the NLTK VADER algorithm we calculate polarity scores for the news headlines to measure the sentiment associated with each article. To further improve our analysis, we introduce an approach by smearing Fast Fourier Transform and Inverse Fast Fourier Transform to analyze patterns or frequencies in the sentiment scores. This technique aims to provide features for enhancing stock market analysis. At the time we gather stock data using the Python y finance library. This includes indicators, like price changes, trading volumes, and other financial measurements. This data is essential for our regression models. We use these models to examine how the features derived from sentiment analysis and FFT components are related and how they correlate with stock price movements. By combining sentiment analysis with regression modeling the main goal of this research project is to provide insights into how news sentiment, FFT components, and stock market trends interact in the market. The results of this research endeavour could potentially equip investors with the knowledge they need to make decisions and develop strategies that contribute to participation, in the stock market.

articleTitle: Privacy Enhanced Lung Cancer Detection by Hi-SN-Net-SSOA Classifier with Attribute Based Encryption Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: For individuals Applying pre-processing using multilayer brightness-preserving method to the acquired photos allows for a thorough examination of each pixel, the removal of noise, and an development in the excellence of the lung image. Features are extracted using gray-level cooccurrence matrix (GLCM) from the noise-removed lung CT picture. Then features are optimally selected using krill herd optimization algorithm (KHOA). Additionally, a hierarchical spiking neural network (Hi-SN-Net) technique is used for classification with hyper parameter tuning based on shark smell optimization algorithm (SSOA). Using CT scans, the proposed Hi-SN-Net-SSOA approach seeks to identify and classify the presence of illnesses. Finally, in order to maintain privacy in our suggested architecture, this study suggests an attribute-based encryption (ABE) technique based on cloud. The proposed Hi-SN-Net-SSOA technique under discussion improves the accuracy up to 99%, precision, sensitivity, and specificity of lung cancer prediction.

articleTitle: Exploring Approaches and Techniques for Human Activity Recognition in Video: A Comprehensive Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Recognizing human activity in videos is a difficult endeavor with many uses in monitoring, health care, sports analysis, and interaction between humans and machines. This paper delves into both traditional methods and cutting-edge deep learning-based approaches, providing a thorough overview of the advancements in the field. Through this survey, seeks to give researchers and practitioners with a comprehensive understanding of the current state-of-the-art techniques, their strengths, limitations, and future directions. Also discussed the importance and challenges associated with human activity recognition. It then presents a taxonomy of different methodologies used in this domain, including handcrafted feature-based strategies, deep learning-based methods and explores the key components involved in human activity recognition systems. Furthermore, this paper highlights the datasets commonly used for evaluating human activity recognition algorithms and provides an analysis of the performance of va rio us techniques on these datasets. In summary, this comprehensive compilation serves as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners working in the field of human activity recognition in videos.

articleTitle: Analysis and Exploration of the Influence of Mother's Physical and Mental Health on Infant Growth Based on Random Forest and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The mother's physical and mental health has a certain impact on the baby's physical and psychological development. This paper aims to explore the laws of this related influence. In order to improve mothers' mental health and optimize the quality of mother-infant interaction, this study established a canonical correlation analysis model. Through canonical correlation analysis, we obtained standardized correlation coefficients between maternal physical and mental indicators and infant sleep quality. Relying on the Bayesian classifier, this paper constructs a relationship model between infant behavioral characteristics and maternal physical and mental indicators, and classifies the infant's behavioral characteristics. In addition, we again built a random forest regression model to predict infants' overall sleep quality. On the basis of the original treatment plan, it is enough to reduce the HADS by one point and strengthen the treatment of HADS by one point. The planning model proposed in this article has important reference value for improving infant sleep quality and other aspects.

articleTitle: Phased Array Thinning Based on Maximal Length Sequences
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Array thinning is used in large phased array antennas to reduce the cost and weight of antenna with graceful degradation in beamwidth and peak sidelobe level. Several optimization techniques have been proposed in the literature to carry out array thinning. Due to their huge computational complexity and memory utilization, the optimization techniques are mostly used for smaller arrays and for smaller thinning factors. In this work, thinning of phased arrays based on maximal length sequences with around 50% thinning percentages is proposed. Simulations are carried out to create Sparse Arrays based on maximal length sequences, and randomly thinned arrays of different lengths. Radiation patterns and beamwidth parameters are computed and compared. The advantages of the proposed M-sequence based arrays such as lower peak sidelobe level and graceful degradation of half power beamwidths and in beamwidth between first nulls even for 50% thinning factor compared to random arrays are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Predicting the Thickness of Solar Films Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the field of measuring the thickness of solar films, traditional specialized instruments are used to detect solar cell films. However, in this paper, a correlation between color values and solar film thickness is found. Therefore, we consider the use of data fitting method- based on the training data fit to determine the thickness of the film. Two traditional data fitting methods, i.e., ridge and polynomial regression, and RBF neural network methods, were also used in the experiments. The results show that the RBF neural network method outperforms the other two traditional methods in terms of fitting accuracy and significantly reduces the error, with relative errors ranging from 0.22% to 6.11%, providing a guiding Study For Thickness Prediction Of Solar Thin Films. Within acceptable range, the method of neural networks can meet the requirements of actual production. This approach reduces costs compared to using laser measurement.

articleTitle: A Teaching and Learning Based Optimization Algorithm for Efficient Routing in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Many technologies offered by Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), such as encrypted financial transactions, media applications, and effective traffic control, depend on Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs). Vehicular network topology is always changing as a result of increased traffic, and network scalability is limited by sparse network dispersion. As a result, maintaining a steady, ideal path is difficult in the network, which increases instability. This study presented Teaching and Learning based Optimisation (TLO), which generates optimal routing in vehicular communication. The results were compared with existing techniques including the Whale Optimisation Algorithm (p-WOA), Harris Hawks Optimisation (HHO) and Multi-Objective Optimisation Algorithm (MOOA). The proposed technique achieved better results in terms of number of Number of alive nodes, including Latency, and Throughput respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Operation of Resonant LLC Converter for EV Applications using PLECS Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: To ensure power supply and meet the performance standards, for line and load transients it is crucial to model the control loop of power supplies. However power supply designers often lack a signal model for the LLC converter in their toolkit. This becomes more challenging with the increasing demand for efficiency. In cases the power supply needs to achieve an efficiency of 96% while maintaining a low THD and a good pf. Such requirements place pressure on the DC DC stage to achieve efficiencies above 96%. The resonance LLC converters are a choice due to their ability to attain high efficiencies. Unfortunately working with this topology has been made difficult by the absence of a user small signal model. This paper strives to address these challenges by providing a signal model, for the LLC converter and offering tools that can be applied in various operating scenarios. These resources aim to assist power supply designers in optimizing their designs.

articleTitle: Infrared Weak Dot Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Meta-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article focuses on the problem of infrared point recognition in infrared weak point target tracking that traditional methods cannot solve, and the tracking results are unstable. Therefore, a meta learning algorithm is proposed for infrared point recognition analysis of infrared weak point target tracking. Firstly, theoretical analysis is conducted using binary datasets, and classification is carried out according to the requirements of infrared point recognition to reduce the problem of target loss caused by occlusion in infrared point recognition. Then, infrared point recognition is performed on the infrared weak point target tracking data node, and the infrared point recognition data is annotated to comprehensively analyze the recognition results of the infrared points. the meta learning algorithm outperforms traditional methods in terms of infrared small point recognition accuracy and infrared.

articleTitle: Lumpy Skin Disease Detection in Cows Using Resnet-50
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is one of the emerging domains where a huge number of applications are being developed to replace human experts and introduce intelligent systems to solve many real-world problems. Lumpy skin disease (LSD) is the most widely spreading disease that affects cows and causes economic losses to the agricultural industry. Due to a lack of veterinary experts, it is becoming difficult to diagnose the disease in its early stages, which leads to the deaths of cows, mostly in Ethiopia, which suffers from a lack of livestock due to the huge spread of the LSD virus in cattle. The proposed machine learning model will classify cow images as lumpy or non-lumps. Initially, an image dataset of cows 80 percent is utilized for training and 20 percent for testing. These images are further processed to reduce noise and intensity using Gaussian filtering and histogram equalization. Then the model will extract features from preprocessed images using a convolutional neural network because it is the one profound for image processing and hence used it. After feature extraction, the Resnet-50 algorithm is trained with the features extracted, and Resnet-50 will classify images into lumpy and non-lumps. The existing models forecast the LSD virus using metrological attributes for predicting the occurrence of LSD. Quantitatively, an overall accuracy of 87 percent using random forest. Resnet-50 Model Classifies the LSD disease in cows using the cow images dataset. Quantitatively, an overall accuracy of 93 percent using the Resnet 50 algorithm.

articleTitle: Investigation on Neural Network Algorithm in Rural E-Commerce Reverse Networks in the 5G Era
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Based on the backpropagation algorithm of Neural Network (NN), this article first provided a brief introduction to NN algorithm, analyzed the specific applications of backpropagation algorithms in NN algorithm, and evaluated the NN algorithm in rural e-commerce reverse networks. Finally, through actual data, a backpropagation experiment was conducted, which increased the daily sales of rural e-commerce to 893 pieces, proving that the application of backpropagation algorithm in rural e-commerce reverse networks could effectively improve the daily sales of rural e-commerce. With the continuous development and progress of science and technology, the arrival of the 5G era has a huge impact on economic and social development. For rural e-commerce, in the 5G era, the research on NN algorithm in rural e-commerce reverse networks can not only effectively improve e-commerce efficiency, but also effectively solve many problems faced in the development of rural e-commerce.

articleTitle: A Novel Energy-Efficient Hybrid Optimization Algorithm for Load Balancing in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the field of Cloud Computing (CC), load balancing is a method applied to distribute workloads and computing resources appropriately. It enables organizations to effectively manage the needs of their applications or workloads by spreading resources across numerous PCs, networks, or servers. This research paper offers a unique load balancing method named FFBSO, which combines Firefly algorithm (FF) which reduces the search space and Bird Swarm Optimization (BSO). BSO takes inspiration from the collective behavior of birds, exhibiting tasks as birds and VMs as destination food patches. In the cloud environment, tasks are regarded as autonomous and non-preemptive. On the other hand, the BSO algorithm maps tasks onto suitable VMs by identifying the possible best positions. Simulation findings reveal that the FFBSO algorithm beat other approaches, obtaining the lowest average reaction time of 13ms, maximum resource usage of 99%, all while attaining a makespan of 35s.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Audit Data Mining Toolbox Based on Massive Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the context of massive data, intelligent auditing faces challenges in data mining efficiency and accuracy. To address this issue, this article proposes a design scheme for an intelligent audit data mining toolbox based on massive data. This plan helps auditors quickly and accurately identify abnormal data and potential risks by analyzing and mining audit data. This article first proposes the problem of intelligent audit data mining, then analyzes the shortcomings of existing technologies and methods. Finally, by designing and implementing this toolbox, an effective solution is provided. Through data simulation, we can know that this toolbox has the characteristics of efficiency, accuracy, and ease of use, providing new ideas and tools for data mining in the field of intelligent auditing, helping to improve audit efficiency and accuracy, and reduce audit risks.

articleTitle: Research on Product Semantic Features Based On Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: To solve the problems of low efficiency of aesthetic law acquisition and imperfect design auxiliary function in the process of industrial product innovation design. a product parameter optimization method is constructed to modify the appearance characteristics of the product according to the principle of digital twin and the principle of perceptual engineering. Firstly, the twin database based on product semantic classification is established. With the help of the twin data, the concrete element cluster classification clustering is carried out to obtain the design experience. The obtained semantic element features are reused to optimize the design scheme. The method is applied to a sound product that requires cute semantics. The results prove the feasibility of the method for product appearance optimization, which effectively assist the product appearance design process and optimize the modeling elements.

articleTitle: A Robust Long Short-Term Memory Model for Classification of Malware Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Malicious software (malware) analysis and classification has obtained a greater development in the systems connected by the Internet. The malware accomplishes the system's data and withdraws significant user data without any declaration. Furthermore, the malware secretly directs the data to the servers which are standardized by the attackers. Recently, various scientists and researchers identified the products of anti-malware to detect known malware. However, these approaches are insufficient to detect packed and obfuscated malware. To solve these issues, Cuckoo Search Algorithm (CSA) was developed for the classification of malware. The efficient features were chosen by the CSA approach which simplifies the process to classify the malware. The classifier of Long Short- Term Memory (LSTM) was employed in this research to classify the malware. The samples of malware are obtained from the VXHeavens dataset which includes malware samples from numerous software. The developed model attained better accuracy of 99.03%, sensitivity of 98.16%, recall of 98.25%, and fl-score of 97.11 % respectively than the existing models.

articleTitle: Shared Learning Platform for English Based on Feature Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Feature extraction algorithms are of great significance in the fields of machine learning and computer vision, but currently English learning resources are limited and there is a lack of a shared learning platform to promote knowledge dissemination and communication. 20 experts were invited to participate, and the results indicated that participants using the platform achieved significant improvements in algorithm accuracy, with an average improvement range of 0.06 to 0.07. This showed that the English shared learning platform for feature extraction algorithms plays an important role in improving algorithm performance. This platform not only provides learning resources and communication opportunities, but also promotes algorithm improvement and knowledge dissemination, thus providing valuable tools for the learning and development of feature extraction algorithms. The recall rate of the Bag-of-words model model is 0.80; that of the TF-IDF is 0.84; that of the Word2Vec is 0.88. Future research should further optimize the user friendliness of the platform and strengthen cooperation and communication to promote further development in this field.

articleTitle: Patient Electronic Health Records Maintenance Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Even though blockchain has been a buzzword for a long time now, blockchain in healthcare is yet to take a big step in the real world. The benefits of having a distribution system to store patient records are immense. The hospitals now have a centralized architecture to store data which makes the system inflexible and inconvenient for the patients to organize their health records that can branch to n number of hospitals with numerous updates and changes. Medical faults are also a major drawback leading to unsuccessful medical attempts. Adding to this, patient data is very sensitive which calls for a more secure system like blockchain. There has been recent research based on these benefits of blockchain and in our proposed system, the blockchain system is entirely private reducing the risk of privacy as well as data breaches. Doctors can consult the patients after viewing their records on the blockchain and the patients can register for the same. Hence, it is a patient electronic health record system developed using the concept of blockchain. Traditional EHR-based systems are prone to data loss, security and immutability consensus over health records, gaped communication among constituted hospitals, among others. Blockchain has been developed as a decentralized technology that holds the promise to address the aforesaid facilities in EHR-based systems. We are working on first attempting to implement EHR using blockchain and then defining fine-grained access rules for network users to provide a high security vault.

articleTitle: Landscape Garden Planning Optimization Algorithm Based on Group Intelligent Optimization Path Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's economy and society, the urban population is increasing and the urban area is also expanding. In this context, landscape garden planning and design is particularly important. This article introduces the basic principles, advantages and application of group intelligent optimization path technology in landscape and garden planning optimization. Through the use of this technology, the planning efficiency can be effectively improved. The use of this technology can greatly reduce manual intervention in traditional landscape garden planning, and greatly improve the efficiency of landscape garden planning and design. The experimental results show that the number of iterations of the landscape garden planning optimization algorithm based on the group intelligent optimization path technology can reach at least 332 times. Through swarm intelligence optimization, we can better understand the needs of tourists or users, thereby planning more practical and humane landscape gardens, and improving the user experience.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Client Reviews on a French E-Commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This research aims to analyze customer reviews on a French e-commerce platform to understand customer perceptions and identify trends. The dataset includes a representative subset of reviews written in French, encompassing a diverse range of products and services. Machine learning techniques, such as recurrent neural networks as well as long short-term memory (LSTM), are used throughout the research to get emotional data via these reviews. The findings will provide valuable insights for businesses looking to improve their products or services by leveraging customer feedback. The research aims to provide valuable insights for businesses seeking to enhance their services.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Precise Management Mode of College Student Service Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article addresses the issue of unsatisfactory management effectiveness. Therefore, this article proposes an ant colony algorithm for service-oriented precision management analysis. Firstly, use positive feedback from information to evaluate the management model, and divide indicators according to the requirements of service-oriented precision management to reduce interference factors in service-oriented precision management. Then, feedback the information to service-oriented college students for precise management, forming a service-oriented precise management plan, and conducting a comprehensive analysis of the results of service-oriented precise management. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, ant colony algorithm is accurate in service-oriented and precise management of college student management.

articleTitle: Design of Efficient Approximate Adders for Error Analysis and Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Numerous compute-intensive algorithms are used for low-energy and high-speed circuits. Approximate computing is an alternative approach that can be employed in error-tolerant applications like audiovisual processing. For low-energy and high-speed circuits, numerous computationally expensive algorithms are used. An alternate strategy can be used in error-tolerant applications like audiovisual processing is approximate computing. In this study, lower logic complexity-based approximation full adder designs are proposed with the goal of reducing latency and energy consumption at the cost of introducing some errors at the output. The proposed and referenced approximate adders are designed in the Verilog HDL language. All adders have been simulated and synthesized by Xilinx Vivado software. The proposed designs show lower logic complexity, low power consumption, and improved error matrix calculations.

articleTitle: IoT Based Lineman Security System Using Controlled Switchover With Transmission Line Fault Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Major problems with the electricity grid include electrical mishaps. Electrical linemen who died at work while doing maintenance made up the majority of deaths. Poor electrical wire charging and discharging, that is due to a privation of coordination and communication is the main reason for these worrying results. While running a transmission line, security measures must be applied. The possibility of a misunderstanding leading to actual harm still exists. Lack of coordination and communication between the maintenance staff and the electric substation, it has been discovered that the number of fatal electrical accidents involving linemen is rising during the repair of electrical lines. The suggested approach offers a remedy that guarantees security of linemen. This work's primary goal is to decrease the frequency of issues that arise when line and light faults occurs. It may also be advantageous to save electricity, saving the life of a lineman who is working on an electric line. In this paper, an effort is made to advanced control & monitoring of a typical lineman security system using NodeMCU (ESP8266) with WiFi Module for integration of IoT. Circuit breaker factors like load current, status of loads are supervised. The supervised data are uploaded to Internet of Things platform “MQTT Application”. Supervised circuit breaker factors are used to monitor the condition of the circuit breaker. In this paper effort is done to advance automated circuit breaker control and monitoring systems which detect the electrical and mechanical condition of circuit breaker, which is real time in operation. This model reduces the unnecessary downtime condition of the transmission line pole. Also, open-source platform is used that removes the worry about security and reliability of the application. And complete source code implementation is open & it is easily available for the consumer to access (user).

articleTitle: Algorithm Design of Perception and Navigation for Unmanned Vehicles Based on Multi-Sensor Fusion and Co- Location
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Aiming at the perception and navigation problems of unmanned vehicles, this paper designs a perception and navigation algorithm based on multi-sensor fusion and cooperative positioning. The algorithm realizes the perception of the environment through multi-sensor fusion technology, and at the same time realizes the high-precision positioning of unmanned vehicles by using collaborative positioning technology. On this basis, the fused data is optimized using a state-space model, which improves the accuracy of perception and navigation results. In order to verify the algorithm proposed in the article, an experimental test was carried out on an unmanned vehicle.
