The test results show that the perception and navigation algorithm designed in this article can increase the perception accuracy to a maximum of 96.8%, and can also effectively improve the positioning accuracy and communication efficiency, and can reduce the collision accidents caused by the vehicle entering the obstacle area by mistake.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition with Smartphone Sensors Using RNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent time, different hardware, smart devices, machine learning model and deep learning model are used for Human Activity Recognition (HAR) applications. The main implication of this question is that which creates HAR models with high accuracy, uses low cost. Smartphones have become an important part of persons life; they play vital role in human activity recognition systems to detect human actions. To recognize human activity, this article proposes the use of Logistic Regression and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), which is used for handling time series data or sequential data. The long-term memory network model recognizes six basic human activities: sitting, standing, walking up and down, lying down, and walking. The LSTM model is an advanced form of Recurrent Neural Network that eliminates leaky gradients and burst gradients of RNN. It helps us to examine past information to perform current tasks or give output based on current input.

articleTitle: Design of a 3D Digital Product Based on DSP Real Time Video Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Image recognition and processing technology is an important application direction of artificial intelligence technology. With the growth of demand for various types of video intelligent analysis, the importance of using multiple models and artificial intelligence technology for image recognition and video analysis has become increasingly prominent. This article delves into the multi object tracking technology in image and video processing, and based on image object detection and recognition algorithms and DSP technology, Real time tracking of products in the production workshop, combined with 3D hybrid modeling technology to create corresponding product models, digitize the produced products, and provide feedback on specific product data. Providing data and graphics support for later analysis of product conformity and understanding of product conditions, improving workshop production efficiency.

articleTitle: Encryption of Accounting Data Based on AES Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article proposes an accounting data en-cryption scheme based on AES algorithm, aiming to protect the confidentiality and integrity of accounting data. This scheme uses AES algorithm to encrypt accounting data, ensuring the security of the data during transmission and storage. This article provides a detailed description of the principle, encryption process, and decryption process of the AES algorithm, and analyzes the advantages and feasibility of this scheme. The experimental results show that this scheme can effectively protect the confidentiality of accounting data, and has high security and reliability. Compared to traditional algorithms, the algorithm proposed in this article can more effectively protect data, and the algorithm efficiency is also improved to 99%.

articleTitle: Intelligent Innovation and Entrepreneurship Platform Based on PSO Algorithm + Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Traditional innovation and entrepreneurship platforms face problems such as low resource utilization efficiency and inaccurate decision-making. In order to solve these problems, this paper adopts the combination of PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm and big data to improve the efficiency, accuracy and intelligence level of the algorithm. This article describes how to apply the PSO algorithm to the innovation and entrepreneurship platform to perform task optimization and decision support in the big data environment, and also optimize the convergence speed of the PSO algorithm, and effectively control the error. By optimizing resource utilization, the overall efficiency and cost-effectiveness of the platform is improved. The improved platform resource utilization rate in this paper has reached 79% −89%, and the intelligent innovation and entrepreneurship platform based on PSO algorithm and big data has achieved significant improvements in algorithm efficiency, accuracy and resource utilization rate. This provides innovative entrepreneurs with a more efficient, accurate and intelligent platform.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation and Prediction of Mechanical System Based on Machine Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The traditional mechanical reliability evaluation method has high demand for data quality and data quantity, and requires a lot of time and manpower in data collection and processing, and there are some errors in the analysis results. The application of machine learning techniques in reliability assessment can predict errors in mechanical systems and make maintenance decisions. By exploring the influence of machine learning technology on the reliability evaluation and prediction of mechanical system, it is found that the application of machine learning techniques can increase the prediction precision and recovery of reliability assessment models for mechanical systems. The accuracy rate has increased by about 8%, the recall rate has increased by 10%, and users are very satisfied with the reliability assessment model of mechanical systems based on metal learning techniques. The results of this paper prove that machine learning technology has broad application prospect and practical significance in the reliability evaluation and prediction of mechanical systems.

articleTitle: Abnormal Target Detection Method in Multispectral Industrial Images Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of multispectral industrial image technology, multispectral industrial image data has been greatly improved in terms of spectrum and spatial resolution, which provides convenience for the acquisition and processing of multispectral industrial image data. However, the existing automatic detection and recognition methods of ground objects often only use the spectral information of ground objects, while ignoring the spectral and spatial correlation between ground objects, and assume that ground objects and ground objects are independent of each other in the airspace, it is often neglected in practical applications. In order to solve this problem, this paper uses a machine learning model to achieve the detection and recognition of multispectral image targets by fusing spectral information and correlation characteristics through generalized likelihood ratio testing. Finally, experiments have proved that the machine learning-based multispectral industrial image abnormal target detection method performs better than other algorithms (F1 value is 0.91, Precision rate is 0.89).

articleTitle: Research on the Energy-Saving Transformation Strategy of Building Ecology Based on Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Virtual Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the increasingly serious problem of global climate change and resource tension, the ecological and energy saving transformation of the construction industry has become an urgent task. The use of artificial intelligence and interactive virtual simulation technology aims to effectively reduce the energy consumption of buildings and improve the energy efficiency of buildings without sacrificing the cost of the living or working environment. This paper mainly applies the way of algorithm comparison and experimental design, analyzes the application of the two technologies in the ecological transformation of buildings, and puts forward the key points of the transformation. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the long-term and short-term memory network algorithm is the highest, the highest is 94.6%, the lowest is 90.7%, all reaching more than 90%. Through the application of artificial intelligence technology and interactive virtual simulation, it provides important support for the energy conservation transformation of architectural ecology. Simulation and optimization of building energy consumption, environmental impact and other indicators, to promote the construction industry to a more sustainable and environmental protection direction.

articleTitle: Prediction of Rainfall Using Seasonal Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average and Transductive Long Short-Term Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: One of the most crucial parts of the practical application in recent years has been the analysis of time series data for forecasting. Because of the extreme climate variations, it is now harder than ever to estimate rainfall accurately. It is possible to forecast rainfall using a number of time series models that uncover hidden patterns in past meteorological data. Choosing the right Time Series Analysis Models for predicting is a challenging task. This study suggests using a Seasonal Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) to forecast values that are similar to historical values that exhibit seasonal patterns. Twelve years of historical weather data for the city of Lahore (from 2005 to 2017) and Blora Regency are taken into account for the prediction. The dataset underwent pre-processing operations like cleaning and normalisation before to the classification procedure. For classification, Transductive Long Short-Term Model (TLSTM) is employed which has learned the dependency values where the memory blocks are recurring and capable of learning long-term dependencies on this model. Further, TLSTM's goal is to increase accuracy close to the test point, where test points are selected as a validation group. The performance of the models has been assessed based on accuracy (99%), precision (98%), recall (96%) and fl-score (98%). Proposed SARIMA model showed optimistic results when compared to existing models.

Author Keywords: Seasonal Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average

articleTitle: Application of High-Resolution Remote Sensing Big Data Analysis in Disaster Loss Assessment of Rice Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This paper comprehensively discusses the understanding of economic loss, loss assessment, direct economic loss assessment and direct economic loss evaluation of rice disaster in China. The analysis results show that the direct loss and the indirect loss assessment are equally important, and the use of reasonable assessment methods to assess the direct and indirect loss of disasters is not only the need of disaster prevention and reduction, but also of great significance to strengthen the management of disaster prevention and control. Combining disaster science and economics organically is an effective method that can effectively improve and evaluate the evaluation of disaster situation.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting the Popularity of VR-Related Educational Videos on TikTok
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Virtual reality (VR) has emerged as a useful educational tool with widespread applications, leading to benefits such as increased student engagement and improved memory retention. These applications and benefits are often discussed on social media platforms such as TikTok, one of the fastest-growing social networks. This research explores the factors affecting the popularity of VR-related educational videos on TikTok. Relevant videos were downloaded from TikTok, and their speech and video content were then analysed through a data pipeline. It was found that videos that included descriptive words, such as specific VR hardware, were more popular. Furthermore, videos that were presented in a split-screen format, featuring concise scenes and on-screen subtitles received the most viewer engagement. Additionally, videos that covered gameplay were the most popular, highlighting the dominance of the game industry in the VR sector. These findings will be of value to companies looking to create and promote VR learning resources.

articleTitle: Classification of Children as Malnourished and Healthy Category Using ResNet18 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: the Malnutrition state is one of the global health crises of a predominant issue for a developing nation considering the children and youngster which effects the development of the nation. Detecting malnutrition in children at an early stage is beneficial in addressing health concerns. In rural region duet paucity of medical doctors often children have difficulty to seek timely attention. Therefore, there is a need for automatic tool for malnutrition detection. This research work is aimed at developing a deep learning model which classify the children as they are under malnutrition, or they are under proper nutrition based on the children image. To carry out this classification a deep learning model based on ResNet18 is designed in this work which is trained and tested on a custom dataset. The model achieves satisfactory performance with 95% accuracy, 97.6% of F1-score and 97.6% of Recall.

articleTitle: Coverage Quality Optimization Strategy for Static Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The coverage quality of static heterogeneous wireless sensor networks is a very important issue in wireless sensor networks and a hot topic of current research. Under the circumstance that the network coverage is unchanged or slightly lost, we can save the total energy consumption of the network by reducing the overlapping coverage area between nodes. The node also starts with the localization method, and obtains the set of overlay intersections by analyzing the information such as the location of the neighbor of one-hop communication, and then obtains the optimal size of the node perception radius by analyzing the set. In view of the one-to-one and one-to-many relationships between nodes and neighbors, node dormancy strategies based on node spacing and segmental arc are proposed respectively. In this paper, the algorithm execution order among neighbor nodes is analyzed, and the concept of execution priority is defined. The node executing algorithm each time is the node with the highest execution priority in the communication range. The algorithm is feasible and has some advantages in reducing the efficiency of network redundancy.

articleTitle: Oral Chinese as a Foreign Language Training Method and System Based on Intelligent Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This article proposes an intelligent question and answer method for writing phrase analysis in response to issues such as incomplete oral training system and improper word usage. Firstly, use cognitive learning theory to evaluate outstanding students and divide indicators according to the requirements of oral Chinese language training for foreigners, in order to reduce interference factors in oral Chinese language training for foreigners. Then, cognitive learning theory evaluates the trainees' writing wording, forms an oral training system plan, and conducts a comprehensive analysis of the oral training results. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the intelligent question answering method is superior to basic wording training, and can make students' writing more professional and practical.

Author Keywords: Learning Chinese as a Foreign Language

articleTitle: Intelligent Movie Recommendation System Based on Hybrid Recommendation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of modern science and technology and the arrival of the artificial intelligence era, the problem of “information overload” has become increasingly prominent. The emerging recommendation systems not only provide users with an excellent user experience and convenience but also help businesses achieve greater profits. To cater to the personalized needs of users, this study has chosen a movie recommendation system based on a hybrid recommendation algorithm. This system reduces the time users spend on information searching and enhances their search efficiency, aiming to recommend movies that align with their preferences. Our hybrid recommendation algorithm has shown an accuracy rate of 81%, surpassing traditional CB, Item-Based CF, and User-Based CF algorithms. This recommendation system not only shortens the time users take to search for information but also improves their search efficiency.

articleTitle: Methods for Generating Scene Animation Based on K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Animation scene design and production is an important part of the animation production process, which involves the layout and environmental design of the animation scene, and has a significant impact on the atmosphere, quality, and emotional expression of the animation. Based on the comparison of experimental results, it was found that compared with the evaluation of traditional and optimized scene animation generation methods by relevant staff, the average improvement in process optimization, output speed, work quality, and generation efficiency was 9%. Compared with traditional scene animation generation methods, the optimized scene animation generation method in this paper has higher scene image generation efficiency, can output more details of scene images, and greatly shorten the time required for animation production. This not only improves the quality of animation, but also promotes the integration of advanced information processing technology with the field of animation production.

articleTitle: Abnormal Recognition Technology of 3D Virtual Scene Image Based on Wireless Network Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The performance and reliability requirements of wireless network sensors are getting higher and higher. In the complex 3D virtualization scene, abnormal recognition of sensor data becomes a challenging task. Therefore, this study aims to explore an effective technique for identifying anomalies in wireless network sensor images in 3D virtualized scenarios. In this study, deep learning techniques were used, combined with image processing and pattern recognition methods, to achieve accurate identification of anomalies in wireless network sensor images. Through training and testing on a large number of 3D virtualized scene images, the experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy in identifying anomalies in wireless network sensor images. The recall rate of the algorithm in this paper is 77%-85%, compared with the traditional method, the method in this paper can more accurately detect and classify various types of abnormal conditions, including signal interference, equipment failure and abnormal data. In addition, the method studied in this paper also shows good real-time performance, which can detect and identify anomalies in real time when processing large-scale sensor data.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Hexagonal Patch Antenna for Wireless and ISM Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In this research, we introduce a hexagonal patch antenna with a hexagonal slot in the Coplanar Waveguide (CPW) feed configuration, specifically engineered for wireless and ISM (Industrial, Scientific, and Medical) band applications. The antenna, with dimensions of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$22 \times 24 \times 1.6 \text{mm}^{3}$</tex> on an FR-4 substrate, demonstrates impressive performance characteristics. It exhibits excellent impedance matching, achieving a return loss below −15dB and a Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) of less than 2. The antenna also attains a substantial gain exceeding 3dBi across the operating frequencies, with an efficiency of over 80%. This study offers a comprehensive analysis of the antenna's radiation patterns. The research underscores the antenna's potential for dual-band operation within the ISM frequency range (2.5 GHz to 5.9 GHz) and its suitability for integration into wireless communication systems. This hexagonal patch antenna presents a compelling solution for a wide range of wireless applications, delivering strong performance, efficient operation, and dual-band capability.

articleTitle: Design of School Assets Management Data Encryption Security System Based on RSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The research on the school asset management data encryption security system aims to develop a safe and reliable system to protect the school asset management data, and meet the legal regulations and compliance requirements, improve the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data management, such a system can ensure that the school's asset information is properly protected. Through the analysis of the characteristics of school asset management data, this paper adopts a school asset management data encryption security system design scheme based on RSA (Rivest Shamir Adleman) algorithm, and on this basis realizes the school asset management data encryption security system. The experimental results show that the system can meet the requirements of school asset management data encryption security, and can effectively prevent various forms of illegal access, thereby ensuring the confidentiality (max=92.6), integrity (max=93.6) and availability (max=97.7) of school asset management data.

articleTitle: Exploration on Malicious Encrypted Traffic Classification Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent years, encrypted traffic has become the main means of network attacks, especially the use of encrypted traffic for network attacks is becoming increasingly common. In real life, some malicious encrypted traffic is attacked through domain name spoofing or domain hijacking, while in the internet, these malicious encrypted traffic is disguised through various means, causing the purpose of network attacks. To address this issue, the article introduced a malicious encrypted traffic classification method based on deep learning (DL). The article first classified encrypted traffic, and then used DL methods to classify it. Finally, the model was trained and tested using multiple datasets. The experimental results showed that the proposed model was superior to other algorithms in accuracy, up to 91.4%, and also had greater advantages in time and space complexity; in addition, the model can also predict unknown attacks.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Approach for Detecting and Classifying the Diabetic Retinopathy by Utilizing an Optimized Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a condition that develops due to diabetes-related harm to the retina. It affects a significant ratio, around 80 percent, of individuals who have had diabetes for more than one decade. Regrettably, the areas needing Diabetic Retinopathy detection lack the essential expertise and equipment. Manual diagnosis of DR can be tedious and error-prone. As a result, numerous artificial neural network based systems have been developed to automate the detection of DR and its various stages using retina images. However, these methods often need help to capture the complex underlying features and exhibit biased accuracy, especially when classifying the early stages of DR. we have implemented an optimized Convolutional Neural Network model. We trained our model with various hyperparameters and finalized the best-performing model with an accuracy of 0.91.

articleTitle: Digital Economy Risk Prevention and Control System with Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The current digital economy is developing rapidly, and the prevention and control of digital risks has become a major issue. This article established a model that can predict risks by combining the generation and discrimination of generative adversarial networks, and then tested the performance of the system through experiments. By collecting digital economy transaction records, a dataset was established as training and testing data, and an adversarial generative network model was designed, with generators used to generate forged risk event samples and discriminators used to identify samples. Then, the dataset was used to train the GAN model and optimize the parameters of the generator and discriminator. Finally, by predicting and evaluating the test data, the performance indicators of the system were analyzed. Through experiments, the system's false alarm rate in this article ranged from 0.01 to 0.04. The digital economy risk control system based on generative adversarial networks can accurately identify and capture real risk events while reducing missed and false alarm rates, and prevent false alarms as much as possible.

articleTitle: An IGA Model for Resource Allocation in Heterogeneous Networks for the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Dynamic obstructions such as trees in the road environment can affect the quality of images captured by industrial cameras. In order to improve the quality of image acquisition in high dynamic scenes, this study proposes a new imaging algorithm based on convolutional neural networks and combined with single exposure high dynamic range imaging methods. This algorithm is mainly divided into a color camera image signal processing link module and a single exposure high dynamic range image enhancement module. The above two modules can improve the resolution of high dynamic range images. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this study can achieve a response time of 63ms at the fastest, with PSNR, SSIM, and perceptual loss scores reaching 38.67, 0.976, and 0.087, respectively. Research has found that this algorithm has good application value in the field of high dynamic range image imaging.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model for Concrete Performance of High-Rise Buildings Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: As one of the basic materials of construction, the performance of concrete has a great influence on the safety of buildings. In order to improve the performance of concrete in civil high-rise buildings and increase its performance without changing the cost of concrete preparation, the study proposes a concrete performance prediction model, the core algorithm of which is the Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) algorithm, and the hyperparameters of BPNN are optimized using the improved Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. The results showed that the multi-objective optimization model for mixing ratio can improve the performance of concrete without changing or reducing the preparation cost of concrete. After optimizing the mixing ratio, the compressive strength of groups A, B, and C increased, and the slump of most mixing methods decreased, while the preparation cost of concrete remained unchanged. The concrete performance prediction model constructed through research can accurately predict the compressive strength and slump of concrete, and optimize the proportion of concrete.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Pain Assessment Approach with Stacked Autoencoders and Attention-Based CP-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Pain assessment is an integral part of healthcare since it enables the optimal management of patient well-being and the prompt administration of therapies. The ability to precisely diagnose pain is essential for ensuring appropriate medical attention and treatment. This study presents a novel pain categorization approach based on EEG (Electroencephalography) signals. A hybrid deep learning-based model is utilized in the study, which combines a Stacked Autoencoder for automated feature extraction and Chebyshev polynomial Long Short-Term Memory (CP-LSTM) with an attention mechanism for classification. The primary objective is to distinguish between two distinct pain states: ‘No Pain’ and ‘Pain’. The proposed model can detect the ‘Pain’ and ‘No Pain’ states of an individual with 99.32% and 98.91% accuracy, respectively. Experimental observations indicate an increase in delta wave power in the frontal and central cortex, as well as an increase in alpha wave power in the frontal, temporal, and occipital lobes during pain.

articleTitle: A Security Sharing Scheme for Personal Data Based on Block-Chain with Fine-Grained Access Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the AI-driven data governance era, privacy and open sharing are critical. Existing data sharing relies on centralized cloud servers, raising privacy and ownership concerns. Encryption and access control help, but they depend on third-party providers' trustworthiness. The BSSPD, a block chain-based security sharing system, addresses this. It uses block chain, cipher text-policy attribute-based encryption (CP-ABE), and the Interplanetary File System (IPFS). Data owners enhance decentralization by storing encrypted data on IPFS. CP-ABE encrypts data addresses and keys as per access policies. Block chain shares data, information, and keys. Only users meeting the criteria can decrypt data. BSSPD offers fine-grained access control and attribute-level revocation, preserving others' access. Cipher text keyword search bolsters user privacy. Security evaluation and EOS block chain simulations validate BSSPD's feasibility. It also performs well in terms of storage and computing overhead, addressing data security and privacy challenges effectively.

articleTitle: Scientific Article Classification: Harnessing Hybrid Deep Learning Models for Knowledge Discovery
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In an era defined by the explosive growth of the scientific literature, the imperative for effective methods of organizing, categorizing, and accessing scholarly articles has become paramount. This study addresses this crucial need by delving into the realm of scientific article classification, aiming to enhance accuracy through the innovative integration of hybrid deep neural networks. Focusing on domains including Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, and Statistics, the research sought to improve categorization using advanced techniques. A comprehensive dataset of 20,006 abstracts was curated through rigorous data collection and preprocessing. Experimental models, spanning various RNN architectures and CNN-RNN based hybrids, were employed to assess the efficacy of the approach. The innovative integration of CNNs and RNNs pioneered new horizons in feature extraction. Key findings reveal the proficiency of hybrid models in capturing both local nuances and sequential dependencies within abstracts. Notably, the CNN-BiGRU model trained on Word2Vec embeddings exhibited highest F1 score of 91.32\%. Furthermore, comparative analysis between GloVe and Word2Vec embeddings underscored the pivotal role of embeddings in extracting semantic information for accurate classification.

articleTitle: Bengali Emotion Classification Using Hybrid Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Emotion classification holds significant importance in various domains. However, the development of accurate emotion classification models for the Bengali language has been relatively limited, despite its vast speaker base. The unique characteristics of Bengali present several challenges for emotion classification. Consequently, there is an urgent demand for robust and contextually-aware emotion classification models tailored to the linguistic nuances of Bengali. This paper presents a comprehensive study on emotion classification in Bengali text, aiming to develop robust and effective models specific to the language. We explored a range of ML and DL models, including LR, SVC, CNN, LSTM, and BiLSTM. Additionally, we proposed novel hybrid architectures, combining CNN with LSTM and CNN with BiLSTM, to leverage both local and contextual information from Bengali text. However, the lack of comprehensive Bengali emotion datasets further hinders the development of dedicated emotion classification models for the language. To facilitate research, we created the ‘Bengali Emotion Dataset’ consisting of 14,334 social media comments, accurately labeled into seven emotion classes. The results demonstrate that the hybrid models, particularly CNN+BiLSTM, outperform individual ML and DL models, achieving the highest accuracy and F1 score of 88.45% and 88.42% respectively. The benchmark dataset and the success of the hybrid model pave the way for more empathetic and contextually-aware natural language processing applications for Bengali speakers.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Gradient Boosting Decision Trees and Dynamic Weights on Maternal Physical and Mental Health on Infants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In this paper, the concept of ensemble learning is first utilized to combine multiple classification and regression models. The mother's gestational age, EPDS, and maternal age are obtained through supervised learning and then examined for their correlation with infant outcomes. Subsequently, the infant's behavioral characteristics are trained, and the accuracy of this model is 64.8. Furthermore, a dynamic programming model is employed to determine the treatment costs required for transforming infant behavioral characteristics into intermediate and calm types, which amount to 40271 yuan and 44277 yuan. Lastly, utilizing dynamic weighting, a comprehensive evaluation of the infant's overall sleep quality is conducted, followed by prediction of the infant's comprehensive sleep quality using a random forest model, achieving a high prediction accuracy of 76.2%. Through the dynamic programming model, it is determined that to elevate the infant's comprehensive sleep quality to excellent, a treatment cost of 42532 yuan is required.

articleTitle: Empowering Healthcare with Deep Learning for Oral Cancer Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Oral cancer early detection and prediction are of paramount importance due to the profound impact they have on patient outcomes, healthcare systems, and public health. First and foremost, early detection significantly improves the chances of survival. When oral cancer is diagnosed in its initial stages, treatment options are more effective, less aggressive, and less debilitating. This translates into higher survival rates and a better quality of life for patients. Moreover, early detection reduces healthcare costs. Treating advanced-stage oral cancer requires more resources, including extensive surgeries, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy. Identifying the disease early minimizes the need for such intensive interventions, thereby decreasing the financial burden on healthcare systems and patients. Therefore, in this paper, we have made an attempt to detect and predict oral cancer at an early stage using Deep Learning techniques such as Convolutional Neural Networks with different activation functions and transfer learning methods such as ResNet50, VGG16, VGG19, and AlexNet. It can be seen that the proposed Customized CNN model outperforms by giving an accuracy of 87.6%.

articleTitle: Research on Mental Health Situations of College Students Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the context of rising societal pressures and mental health challenges among college students, a profound understanding of their psychological well-being is crucial. This research employs machine learning algorithms to analyze the mental health situations of college students, aiming to lay groundwork for effective interventions and support systems. Utilizing advanced machine learning techniques, we dissect large-scale data related to students' mental health, uncovering critical factors and trends. Our predictive models successfully anticipate students' mental health status, thereby pinpointing potential risks and forming the basis for personalized care. Significant findings of the study include the identification of a strong correlation between academic stress, social interactions, and mental health outcomes. We also discovered pronounced differences in mental health trajectories based on gender, academic year, and personal background, emphasizing the need for tailored intervention strategies. For instance, freshmen exhibited higher levels of stress but were more receptive to counselling, while students from diverse backgrounds showed increased susceptibility to environmental shifts, necessitating specialized support structures. By leveraging these insights, educational institutions can craft targeted mental health programs, enhancing student well-being, reducing stress, and promoting comprehensive academic and personal development. Our research not only offers a scientific foundation for these strategies but also underscores the critical role of machine learning in mental health assessments and intervention planning.

articleTitle: Physics-informed Machine Learning Framework for Approximating the Modified Degasperis-Procesi Equation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The Degasperis-Procesi (DP) equation, is a prominent nonlinear partial differential equation (PDEs) with important applications in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) in particular wave propagation. It poses significant challenges when seeking accurate numerical solutions, especially in the context of boundary value problems. This article presents a novel approach for solving the boundary value problem associated with the DP equation utilizing Physics-informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Traditional numerical methods often struggle to capture the complex wave dynamics and steep gradients inherent in the DP equation. In contrast, PINNs leverage the power of artificial neural networks and physical principles to learn and approximate the underlying solution without relying on a predefined grid. This article contributes to the growing body of research in the application of machine learning techniques to solve challenging partial differential equations, particularly for problems where traditional numerical methods encounter limitations. Our PINN model has been able to reduce the computational cost. Though the undertaken problem is high dimension, but PINN does not suffer for curse of dimensionality.

articleTitle: Music Recognition and Classification Recommendation Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the continuous popularization and development of the Internet, digital music resources continue to increase, how to effectively organize and manage these huge music resources, and explore related music resources effectively, in order to achieve the purpose of fast and accurate retrieval of these information, is an urgent problem in the field of music resource retrieval. The existing emotion recognition methods, no matter the single word or single sound emotion recognition methods, have their own shortcomings. In view of this, this topic proposes to effectively integrate the feature extraction capability of convolutional neural networks with the time series information of LSTM. On this basis, by studying the attention mechanism of CNN-LSTM, a single pattern recognition method based on CNN-LSTM is constructed for emotion recognition of sounds and music. Then, a composite neural network which can support the two types of feature information is constructed to improve the classification accuracy through the effective fusion of the two types of feature information. Compared with SVM, CNN, LSTM and other methods, this method has a great improvement, its accuracy reaches 68%, and the lyrics accuracy reaches 74%.

articleTitle: Multimodal sentiment analysis using Multi-Layer Fusion Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The rapid development of social network helps the people to express the emotions and opinions through videos streaming in online platforms. But, most of the recent researches based on multimodal sentiment analysis does not perform an effective fusion on multimodal data. To overwhelm this issues, this research introduced a multilayer fusion Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to perform a multimodal sentiment analysis. The data acquisition is performed from CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI, the textual data is processed by tokenization and BERT; the video embedding is performed using FACET transformer and Mel-spectrogram with VGGish is used in encoding. At last, the decoding takes place using Multilayer Fusion CNN. The results obtained through experimental analysis shows that proposed approach achieved optimal accuracy of 94.61 % for MOSI dataset which is comparably higher than hybrid contrastive learning method, Multi-Tensor Fusion Network (MTFN), Sparse- and Cross-Attention Network (SCANET) and Adaptive Modality-specific Weight fusion network (AdaMoW) with accuracies of 85.2%, 80.9%, 85.98%, and 86.58% respectively.

articleTitle: A Fraud Detection System in Financial Networks Using AntiBenford Subgraphs and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Detecting financial fraud within banking systems and digital transactional ledgers is a complex challenge that demands robust methodologies. One such approach is graph mining, which delves into datasets to reveal patterns and relationships, particularly in financial networks. The AntiBenford subgraph, inspired by Benford's Law, is tailored for identifying irregularities in financial transactions. However, it has been known to produce false positives. To address this issue, a proposed solution combines the AntiBenford subgraph with an unsupervised Machine Learning Algorithm (MLA). This innovative Fraud Detection System significantly bolsters security within financial networks. Scrutinizing leading digits and examining deviations from Benford's Law expectations effectively pinpoints anomalies in numerical data, a crucial step in identifying potential fraudulent activities. Thanks to its incorporation of MLA techniques, the system adapts and refines its capabilities over time, making it a powerful tool for early detection of financial misconduct. This research contributes a valuable asset to the financial sector, reinforcing security and trust by enabling the early detection of fraudulent transactions. By leveraging Benford's Law and machine learning, this system plays a pivotal role in safeguarding against financial misconduct, ultimately providing a 94.83% accuracy rate in fraud detection, a testament to its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Geometric-Based Passive Bearing-Only Localization Model for UAV Flight
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In order to conduct pure bearing passive localization for UAV formations and enable adjustments of UAVs within the formation, this paper is based on geometric properties and establishes a pure bearing passive localization model, providing a position adjustment scheme. For the passive receiving signal UAVs with deviations, we establish a UAV polar coordinate positioning model, considering the positional relationship between the passive receiving signal UAV and two transmitting signal UAVs, to obtain the position expression of the receiving signal UAV. Next, we consider the passive localization problem in the case of unknown numbering. Apart from one UAV at the center and one UAV in the surrounding area, we need two UAVs emitting signals. By using a three-circle intersection positioning model, we can obtain the positions of all UAVs. In the actual UAV formation scheme, we set up a fixed UAV group based on the initial positions. Then, we propose the step-by-step circular model and the angle equal distribution arrangement model, achieving an even distribution of UAVs on the circumference, and providing their final positions. Finally, based on the formula, the maximum error is approximately 10.5%. This paper rigorously reasons about the above situations and proposes corresponding localization models and adjustment schemes.

articleTitle: A Control Method for Regulating Power Supply Based on the Combination of Ant Colony Algorithm and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Currently, the power system planning software developed domestically and internationally mainly focuses on the current power structure of fossil energy generation, based on traditional power generation optimization and scheduling models. Existing planning software platforms are difficult to adapt to the flexible regulation of coal electricity and new energy collaborative planning needs, and lack the construction of carbon emission assessment modules. This article designs a platform architecture for collaborative planning and carbon emission assessment of multiple types of regulated power sources and new energy, establishes a basic database for grid transmission network planning, develops functional modules for collaborative planning and carbon emission assessment of multiple types of regulated power sources and new energy, integrates key technologies for collaborative planning of multiple types of regulated power sources and new energy. The results indicate that this algorithm overcomes the shortcomings of genetic algorithm which can obtain the local optimal solution. It also shortens the task scheduling time of cloud computing system and achieves better task scheduling effect. The average cost of the tasks completed by the algorithm is obviously lower than that of the other two algorithms and the solution is better.

articleTitle: Optimization of Performance Management for Commercial Companies by Integrating ROF and Light GBM Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Performance management in commercial companies is related to the operation and development of enterprises, and as a core competitiveness of enterprises, it can promote the achievement of strategic goals. Research and analyze the key performance indicator method, target management method, balanced scorecard, and 360 degree performance evaluation method, combined with the current situation and future development direction of performance management in commercial companies, and establish performance evaluation indicators and standards based on enterprise goals to promote the achievement of enterprise strategic goals. After comparing the datasets of random forest model, rotating forest model, and classification model based on rotating forest and Light GBM, it was found that the ROF -LGB model accounted for 75% and 66.7% of the micro average gap and macro average gap, respectively, with an accuracy of 82.6%. It has been proven that the classification model based on rotating forest and Light GBM has high accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Using NSCTS and DCNN, Rapid Prediction and Forecasting of Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Utilizing the CAD system, which aids radiologists in various diagnostic procedures, a recent study has been conducted on the early identification of breast cancer. Next to lung cancer, breast cancer ranks among the most deadly diseases. Initially, detection is done based on screening tests done through Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), subsequently Infrared thermography, and digital mammography (DM). Whenever a suspicion is raised, these tests might be recommended by the specialist. Region-based segmentation is used for the test picture in this work, while NSCTS (Non-subsample Contourlet transform segmentation) is used for preprocessing. ResNet-164 DCNN architecture performs feature extraction and classification between normal and aberrant tumor pictures. The diagnosis system adopts the deep learning technology to increase its performance rate. The approach to prediction starts with screening test photos, then preprocessing to enhance the image quality, ROI detection, ROI segmentation, and classification. The resulting images are examined using a variety of evaluation measures, including performance rate, sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. When compared to other recent work, the outcome is exceptional. The obtained accuracy, sensitivity of the proposed system is 98.58% and 98.78%. The application takes advantage of the MIAS mammography image dataset.

articleTitle: Research on the Digital Model of Substation Inspection System Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This research paper explores the application of digital twin technology in the development of a substation inspection system. The study aims to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of substation inspection and maintenance processes by leveraging real-time data, advanced analytics, and simulation capabilities offered by digital twin technology. Validation and testing procedures are carried out to evaluate the performance of the digital twin-based system. Five case studies are conducted to assess the system's performance in substation inspection, maintenance, fault detection, and diagnosis. The results demonstrate the superiority of the digital twin-based system in terms of accuracy, efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and maintenance time reduction. A comparison with traditional approaches highlights the limitations of these methods and emphasizes the benefits of the digital twin-based system. The research provides valuable insights for industry professionals, researchers, and policymakers seeking to adopt and implement digital twin technology in the power sector. The findings contribute to advancing substation inspection and maintenance practices and showcase the potential of digital twin technology in optimizing substation performance and reliability.

articleTitle: A Robust XG-Boost Machine Learning Model for Water Quality Estimation System by Leveraging with Chi-Square Forward Sequential Feature Selection Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Water quality estimation entails evaluating multiple parameters encompassing physical factors and chemical constituents. Precise assessment of these parameters is crucial for safeguarding water resources, environment, and human health. In the context, machine learning is essential due to its ability to analyse complex datasets and identify intricate patterns within diverse water quality parameters. Machine learning models enhance accuracy, enable timely decision-making, and facilitate proactive interventions for effective water quality estimation. Towards this, the researchers introduce an innovative approach to water quality estimation utilizing a robust XG-Boost machine-learning model, augmented by the Chi-Square Forward Sequential Feature Selection technique. The proposed XG-Boost algorithm, renowned for its high accuracy and resilience, serves as the core predictive model. By integrating the selected features and fine-tuning hyper parameters, proposed XG-Boost model demonstrates superior performance in water quality estimation compared to Optimizable Naive Bayes, KNN and SVM methods. Rigorous Holdout cross-validation and evaluation metrics validate the proposed model's reliability and generalizability. Furthermore, the research addresses the challenge of model interpretability by elucidating the relative importance of selected features, offering a deeper understanding of the key factors influencing water quality. The results claimed in this study envisages, the proposed XG-Boost machine-learning model, in conjunction with the Chi-Square Forward Sequential Feature Selection technique, represents a robust and effective solution for precise water quality estimation. This proposed contribution enhances water resource management and environmental safeguarding with an accuracy of 96.82%, offering versatile applications in public health and environmental engineering.

articleTitle: Image Captioner: Captioning for Visual Impact
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Image captioning is the process of generating a textual description that accurately represents the features of an image. In the realm of deep learning, this task is of utmost significance and has a wide range of uses. Image captioning involves converting an image, represented as a sequence of pixels, into a sequence of words that are relevant to the image. It can be seen as an end-to-end and sequence-to-sequence challenge, as both the language and visual aspects need to be processed. In this regard, recurrent neural networks are employed for the language processing, while convolutional neural networks are used to extract feature vectors from the images. The findings of this study highlight the effectiveness of this method and show how diverse applications in image processing and description generation are possible. This work promotes the incorporation of these methods into actual image captioning systems in order to provide more precise and contextually appropriate image descriptions.

articleTitle: Beyond the Screen: An Exploration of Theoretical Foundations and Paradigms in Human-Computer Interface Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This paper delves into the multifaceted landscape of Human-Computer Interface (HCI) design, meticulously exploring the foundational theories and cutting-edge paradigms that form the backbone of the digital user experience. It skillfully synthesizes profound insights gleaned from seminal works, including Norman's cognitive model and Fitts' law, as well as delving into socio-technical theories such as Activity Theory and Distributed Cognition. These collective theories illuminate the intricate tapestry of human cognition, motor control, and the dynamic interactions between individuals, technology, and their environment. Furthermore, this paper rigorously analyzes the frontiers of HCI through emerging paradigms like natural user interfaces and affective computing, underlining the paramount importance of user-centered design principles in fostering empathy, inclusivity, and accessibility. By comprehensively exploring and elucidating the theoretical foundations of HCI, this work aspires to invigorate innovative, user-centric design approaches, thus enriching the future of human-computer interactions and enhancing the overall user experience within the digital realm.

articleTitle: Exploratory Investigation and Alzheimer's Disease Classification Utilizing Ensemble Models in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: The Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a highly prevalent neurodegenerative disorder that affects an estimated 20 million people worldwide. It is characterized by changes in behavior, deteriorated cognitive abilities, and memory loss. For prompt intervention and efficient treatment of Alzheimer's disease (AD), it is imperative to identify and diagnose the disease as early as possible. In recent years, machine learning methods have become increasingly popular for detecting Alzheimer's disease (AD), with clinical data being used as the main source of information. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the detection of Alzheimer's disease using machine learning techniques. In this research, several key components are included, including data preprocessing, visualization of feature relevance, and evaluation of performance for five ensemble classifiers: Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, Extra Trees, and Bagging. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to reduce the number of attributes of a model and better understand the importance of particular features within the dataset. In addition, the research rigorously evaluates the efficacy of the classifier by utilizing a distinct test dataset. The models' prediction powers are assessed by calculating and reporting various metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-score.

articleTitle: Information Security Technology Based on Remote GPS Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the existing system to add security technology, this paper makes the existing system more practical, the purpose is to achieve the VPN virtual private network function, so that the transmitted data can be safely transmitted on the Internet. Based on the principles of the Internet Protocol Security (IPsec), the System connects existing Global Positioning System (GPS) data to the virtual private network so that GPS data can be transmitted securely. It can send and receive data using serial interface, and can transmit data across the network. Through the design of the database, it can understand how to write the database, and how to use the remote terminal to read the database data. In this paper, the password policy success rate is 93%, and the data backup strategy success rate is 92%. This paper is of great significance to improve the level and technical level of water traffic safety information system.

articleTitle: Dark Assistant: A Novel ML-Based Real-Time Object Recognition System for Blinds
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This project focuses on developing an object identification system using Raspberry Pi, aiming to assist individuals with visual impairments in recognizing and identifying objects in their surroundings. The system leverages the capabilities of Raspberry Pi, combining it with computer vision techniques to provide real-time object recognition. The hardware setup includes a Raspberry Pi board, a camera module, and a speaker or headphones for audio feedback. The software implementation involves installing and configuring the operating system on Raspberry Pi and integrating computer vision libraries, such as OpenCV, for image processing and analysis. The object identification algorithm follows a multi-step process. Two controlled experiments are conducted where two state of the art object detection models SSD and YOLO are tested in how they perform in accuracy. Results show that the SSD model slightly outperforms YOLO in accuracy, but with the low processing power that the current generation of Raspberry Pi has to offer, none of the two performs well enough to be viable in applications where high speed is necessary. Object recognition is done by the Pre-trained model MobileNet for recognizing the object with significant accuracy. The proposed model time utilization for multiple object identification in same distance is from minimum of 16.7% to maximum of 20% in cumulative basis.

articleTitle: Hybrid Cocky Search Algorithm with Hill Climb Approach for solving the Quality-of-Service Multicast Routing in MANET
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Multicast QoS routing is a significant research subject in networks. In so many research has intensive on the low-cost multicast routing tree that fulfills the limits of bandwidth and delay of jitter. Because of its complete problem, many procedures have been agreed to solve this type of difficult. The study offered a novel hybrid algorithm, namely Cocky Search Algorithm, and the Hill Climb (CSAHC), to resolve the issue. The most important ground-breaking task is to association the process of generating the CSAHC procedure solution with the cloud model (CM). In addition, as part of the CSAHC framework, we have integrated the cloud model into the CSAHC algorithm to improve the performance of the CSAHC procedure by optimizing the pheromone trace at the edges. While the high intensity of the pheromone trail can fall into an optimal space on some edges, the CM-based pheromone search strategy is areas. To neglect the option of forming a cycle, we develop integrate it into the path creation procedure. Lastly, the calculation results show that the hybrid procedure has the compensations of effective and superior presentation for the excellence of the solution.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Approach for Predictive Maintenance of Metro System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Predictive maintenance is a method used to analyze the real-time and historical data from the various sensors deployed in critical areas of a machinery to detect the failures and their impact. This paper proposes a study to measure the effectiveness of supervised and unsupervised machine learning models for accurate and efficient detection of failures by using techniques such as anomaly detection, clustering, bagging, and ensemble methods. The study analyzes multivariate time series data of various sensors deployed on the Air Production Unit (APU) of the Metro Do Porto train system. The primary goal is to develop a flexible pipeline to be implemented in rail transportation industry with ease, The data-driven approach improves the maintenance practices and minimize inoperability time and save costs. LSTM was found to be the best performer with an accuracy of 99.8% accuracy and recall of 95%.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Framework for Student Course Recommender System for Higher Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: With the advancement in technology like Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) there are many sub fields which are emerged from the core areas. Deep Learning (DL) is one such field which is gaining vast importance and is often mentioned as branch of ML and AI. In order to quickly and efficiently find the relevant information on the internet based on our past browsing history, recommender systems are playing a major role. Many such systems has been proposed in recent works. Recommender system has been implemented in major E-commerce sites like Amazon, Flipkart, Netflix, YouTube and many other giants have introduced AI based recommendation systems. Most of these systems uses the algorithms which can efficiently collect user behavioral data, filter it and recommends the user various choices based on the previous data. These systems often need to develop their own framework and algorithms which can solve the purpose. Students are often confused to opt for courses out of various options available in today's digital world. Based on their skill, interest the system should recommend a course. A general framework where it can handle data diversity, various dimensions and stimulation types is needed. Deep learning based generalized framework can solve such type of issues. In this paper we propose such generalized and effective Deep learning framework for a student course recommendation system for students who wish to pursue a course in various Higher Educational Institutions. The recommender system can be useful for the students who wish to opt a particular course based on their past history of interest and data collected from the logs. In this paper we use the Intel OpenVino toolkit for the deployment of the recommender system. The recommender system which is based on deep learning will provide the student with the exact set of modules he need to choose based on his skill set. The result of a student recommender system using deep learning can vary depending on several factors, including the quality of the data, the effectiveness of the model, and the specific goals of the recommender system. In this paper we focused on better performance, personalized learning paths and enhanced student satisfaction.

articleTitle: Design of Transmission Gate Based SRAM Using Dynamic Modification Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: There is a huge need of thousands of kilobytes of computer memory for various applications which can function in the sub-threshold domain. SRAM stands for Static Random Access Memory, and it is made up of flip-flops to store the data. The existing 6T and 8T SRAM cell have their disadvantages like high power consumption, slow access time, and delay. To overcome these limitations, in this project, two design methodologies are implemented. The first design methodology employs a Transmission Gate (TG) for improving SRAM performance. By incorporating TG Logic, the read operation in the SRAM architecture experiences reduced delays, leading to enhanced performance. The second design methodology involves a Power Gating approach. Power gating is a low-power technique in advanced technology standards. Since SRAM plays a critical role in modern computing systems, its security is of utmost importance and the power gating technique will reduce leakage power and decreases latency by more than 80% in comparison with the standard 6T SRAM. The design is implemented in the Tanner EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tool, employing 45nm library files. The laboratory findings highlight the potential of the unique method of boosting SRAM security in computing systems like Internet of Things (IoT) applications.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Brain Tumor MRI Image Using Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In this world, brain tumors are recognized as a leading cause of mortality in both children and adults. Brain tumor classification and segmentation are the most important processes in image processing to locate as well as detect regions in unusual tissues. The tumor in a brain can affect the nerve cells, blood vessels and soft tissues. The early diagnosis of brain tumors is significant, it enables the doctors to assess the best treatment and improves the patient's survival rate from death. In this study, brain tumor Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) using the Harris Hawks Optimization algorithm is proposed for the segmentation of MRI images. The brain tumor datasets such as BRATS 2012, BRATS 2019 as well and BRATS 2020 are used to evaluate the performance of the proposed method. The noise removal and skull stripping method are used for the image pre-processing and segmented by the Fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering with the Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO) algorithm. The Black Widow Optimization (BWO) algorithm is utilized for the feature selection process and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm is utilized for the classification. The proposed method achieves better results on specificity and sensitivity and the values of about 97.03% and 98.01% respectively.

articleTitle: Earth Quack Prediction of Southern California Using Unsupervised Clustering Based Ensemble Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: Predicting when and where an earthquake will occur is a persistent topic in seismology that has attracted the interest of researchers and the general public. There is currently no physical or statistical model that can reliably anticipate the occurrence of major earthquakes, despite continuous research into the fundamental factors that cause them. Random forests and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks are two examples of machine learning techniques that show promise for enhancing earthquake prediction accuracy because of their ability to quickly discover patterns in vast databases. An unsupervised ensemble learning model trained on a labeled dataset has been built for earthquake detection in this article. An unlabeled dataset can be transformed using an ensemble machine learning strategy, which is the result of combining clustering methods with weighted voting. The Adaptive Tunicate Swarm Optimization Algorithm (ATSOA) is used to select the LSTM's weight. The dataset gathered by the Southern California Seismic Network is used for the method's training and testing. The results show that the suggested technique has a high potential for accurate seismic signal detection and phase identification. The provided approach outperforms other suggested deep learning algorithms on the Southern California Earthquake Data Center's recorded dataset by around 4% in earthquake detection and by a small margin in seismic phase identification. Furthermore, the experimental result shows that the model is reliable in recognizing low-magnitude seismic phases. Finally, we conclude that the suggested learning provides a viable option for enhancing earthquake occurrence prediction, and that minor earthquakes include information useful to forecasting future maj or earthquakes.

articleTitle: A Collective Approach to SMS Spam Detection: Harnessing the Power of Multimodal Features, Machine Learning, and Advanced Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In the current of mobile communication, Short Message Service (SMS) remains a dominant means of interaction despite the proliferation of messaging apps. Unfortunately, this increase in SMS traffic has given rise to an increase in SMS spam. This unwelcome phenomenon has become a conduit for advertising and fraudulent activities, causing significant inconvenience and harm to users. Thus, achieving a better way of SMS spam filtering is a formidable challenge. In this research, a machine learning based approach to spam SMS detection is used. This approach uses a variety of machine learning algorithms, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Multinomial Naive Bayes (MNB), Voting Classifiers, Stacking Classifiers and many other ML models. The best model based on its performance, measured by accuracy and precision is found out to be Multinomial Naïve Bayes, this model is chosen and further used for spam and ham classification. This model resulted in accuracy of 97% and precision of 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. This shows that multinomial naïve bayes is the most suitable model for this classification task.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for Diagnosis Cardiovascular Disease Using Clinical Features, ECG and MRI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: According to the WHO, cardiovascular diseases (CVD) is the biggest cause of death worldwide; over 17 million people died from CVD in the year 2019, which is a major health concerns for public. Effective prevention and treatment of cardiovascular diseases depend on early detection and in this regard, artificial intelligence techniques have demonstrated great promise. In recent years, MRI images have emerged as a powerful non-invasive modality for evaluating heart problems and its functions so this research study uses clinical features, ECG and MRI images to accurately diagnose diseases. This hybrid model utilize a combination of demographic, clinical, and lifestyle factors and depending on the severity of the disease, ECG and MRI scanning is advised. First CNN models is trained using ECG signals and it predicts the class of disease. The second CNN model predicts the classes of MRI data. This hybrid model uses the results of ensemble, CNN on ECG data, and CNN on MRI images to predict the likelihood of disease in the region of interest. Auto encoders are also used to remove the noise from MRI images. The aggregate accuracy of the three sub models is 93.4% which is superior performance than existing methods using clinical features with ECG and MRI data.

Author Keywords: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) Clinical Features Machine Learning

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Control and Prediction Model Empowered with 5G Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: This research paper addresses the escalating challenges of urban traffic congestion and diminished driving safety resulting from the burgeoning automobile population. The study formulates an innovative framework for an Enhanced Traffic Management Model (ETMM) leveraging the convergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and 5G technology. Through in-depth interviews with a diverse panel of experts and comprehensive data analysis, the framework integrates real-time and historical data streams for accurate traffic prediction, congestion estimation, and dynamic signal optimization. The findings reveal that the proposed ETMM substantially improves traffic flow, minimizes travel time, and enhances urban mobility. Additionally, the research demonstrates the viability of AI-driven approaches for traffic management, underscored by successful model deployment and validation. The future scope lies in refining the framework with continuous data updates, incorporating user-centric insights, and expanding its applications to create safer, more efficient urban transportation systems.

articleTitle: Detecting Parkinson's Disease with Prediction: A Novel SVM Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In recent years, the prevalence of neurological diseases has been on the rise due to an increasing population and aging. Conditions like Parkinson's disease, stroke, cerebral palsy, and others often lead to dysarthria among patients. Detecting and treating Parkinson's disease promptly is crucial as it can pose challenges to managing the disease's progression and have adverse effects on a patient's mental and physical well-being when symptoms worsen. Previous research has been predominantly using the concept of machine learning for Parkinson's exposure. This study introduces a novel integrated Support Vector Machine archetypal for detecting the disease by gathering data, organizing it followed by training and testing, finally assessing its performance thereby decreasing the causalities. The experimental findings indicate the use of SVM model proposed in the research achieves an accurateness rate of 87 percentages and f1-score of 0.87%.

articleTitle: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Network Applications in Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Ambient Intelligence, Knowledge Informatics and Industrial Electronics (AIKIIE)
abstract: In response to the issues of low accuracy and stability in stock market prediction models, this paper introduces a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention prediction model. It consists of three components: firstly, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) layer is used to extract local features from historical stock data. These features are then passed to a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) layer, which is capable of capturing long-term dependencies in time series data and providing a deeper contextual understanding.
